jobs.title: Closed Procedure: Senior Account Director - Strategic Account in Maritime Logistics for SITA
jobs.description:
Senior Account Director - Strategic Account in Maritime Logistics for SITA

 

Executive summary: A senior international key account role for a professional who excels in relationship management, stakeholder engagement, and strategic account development. In this position, you will be responsible for retaining, deepening, and further strengthening the partnership with one of SITA’s ( https://www.sita.aero/about-us/ )  most strategic clients.

Highlights: Senior Account Director - Strategic Account in Maritime Logistics | SITA

·      End-to-end responsibility for a strategic international key account

·      Strong focus on relationship management, retention, and deepening the partnership with C-level, IT directors, Enterprise architects, both on the IT organization of the client as well the Business organization.

·      International sales and stakeholder management role with high visibility in the customer environment

·      Significant impact on client satisfaction, continuity and commercial development, including revenue management

·      Strong focus on managed IT and Connectivity services (infrastructure) and differentiated value propositions, based on the portfolio of SITA

·      Key position within an international team and complex IT enterprise and Business environment

·      Operational / dotted leadership of a highly skilled IT team of 6 FTE at client site

 

Purpose of the role

For SITA, we are looking for a Senior Account Director who will take international responsibility for the strategic international key account. In this role, the emphasis is on retaining, deepening, and future-proofing an existing client relationship with significant commercial and operational value. The focus is not on aggressive revenue growth, but on stability, continuity and additional commercial opportunities within an established international account.

 

About the role, building future proof relationships

As Senior Account Director, you will be responsible for managing and further developing the strategic international key account within SITA. You will operate in an international environment where relationship development focusing on account retention, you understand the complexity of enterprise. IT, data and connectivity sales and know how to create structural value within an existing client relationship.

 

The ideal candidate is an experienced sales professional with proven knowledge of strategic international key account as an organization, for example from a previous role as a supplier or strategic partner. IT knowledge and experience with managed services are important, but deep client knowledge, insight into decision-making structures, and an understanding of international stakeholder dynamics are even more critical in this position. You can build sustainable relationships at multiple levels, create internal and external alignment in a smart and distinctive way.

 

About SITA

SITA has been a leading technology partner for the international travel and transport sector since 1949. In its early years, the SITA company built one of the first large-scale communications networks for aviation and today continues to play a global role in making travel and logistics processes smarter, safer, and more efficient. SITA has since expanded this expertise into maritime services and managed services for logistics organizations

 

SITA supports organizations with contact center solutions, connectivity, digital collaboration, security, and managed services. Within this context, strategic international key account for whom SITA delivers services worldwide that directly contribute to customer contact, collaboration, and operational continuity.

Client context

The strategic international key account one of the world’s leading container shipping and logistics companies, with approximately 18.000 employees globally, 340 + offices in 120 + countries, and connections to more than 550 ports worldwide. The organization is known for its strong focus on quality, digitalization, customer centricity, and operational excellence.

For this role, insight into the international dynamics of a complex logistics organization is essential. You understand how technology, service delivery, and stakeholder management come together in an environment where continuity, reliability, and client satisfaction have a direct impact on the business.

The partnership between SITA and the strategic international key account is built on a strong foundation. Your assignment will be to further deepen this relationship, strengthen SITA’s position, and carefully and strategically develop new opportunities within the account.

 

Portfolio and services at the key account

·       Contact centre and voice solutions

·       Global connectivity solutions

·       Managed services for communication and office environments

·       Management of digital workplaces and office environments

·       Security solutions

 

What will you do?

·       You will have end-to-end responsibility for the international account management strategic key account within SITA.

·       You will build and deepen sustainable relationships with stakeholders at operational, tactical, and strategic levels.

·       You will safeguard the existing revenue base and drive maximum client retention in an environment where managed services are largely viewed as a commodity.

·       You will identify commercial opportunities and translate them into distinctive, relevant, and viable propositions.

·       You will clearly operate as a farmer rather than a hunter account retention, and strategic growth is the main focus.

·       You will position SITA as a partner that adds value more intelligently, effectively, and innovatively than the market expects.

·       You will work effectively with internal teams, senior stakeholders, and specialists to serve the client optimally.

·       You will provide day-to-day direction to a highly skilled IT delivery team of 6 FTE at the client (virtual and extended account team).

 

Terms of employment

This position offers a fixed gross monthly salary between €9.000,- and €11.000,- gross monthly, complemented by an attractive variable compensation model. The bonus structure consists of a sales incentive based on revenue, with approximately 40% of the variable compensation linked to renewals. In addition, you will receive commission on closed deals. With strong performance, a total package of up to approximately €160,000 OTE is achievable.

Procedure

Following a successful introductory phone call, you will have 2 face-to-face meetings with a SoundPeople senior consultant. If both sides see sufficient reason to move forward, we will introduce you to SITA. You will then go through three interview rounds with the client:

 

The first interview round will take place with a Account Executive of SITA (Central Europe) and an HR professional. The second round will be with the SVP of Central Europe and the current Account Director. In the final stage, the ultimate selection and terms of employment will be aligned with the President of Europe and the COO.

 

Interested?

 

This opportunity is designed for an accomplished enterprise account leader who understands that a mature strategic relationship still requires energy, precision and continuous development. If you can combine executive stakeholder management with commercial ownership and coordinated delivery, we would like to hear from you.

 

Contact Sven Fremeijer at Sound People BV, Executive Search

LinkedIn:  https://www.linkedin.com/in/svenfremeijer/


Who are we looking for?

We are looking for a senior sales professional with extensive experience in complex enterprise environments and a strong understanding of international client dynamics. Ideally, you know the strategic international key account from a supplier or partner perspective and understand the organization, its decision-making processes, and the interests at play. You combine commercial sharpness with high-level know how to create momentum based on trust, substance, and personal leadership.

 

·      Proven experience in MSP, IT, managed services and/or Telco environments

·      Deep client knowledge and preferably previous experience with strategic key account

·      Creative, innovative, and strategically strong in commercial positioning

·      Excellent networker and a credible sparring partner at C-level

·      Structured, results-driven, and operationally strong

·      Able to move organizations forward through relationships and trust, rather than hierarchy or pressure

·      Must: Excellent communication skills in an international environment.

DAS BIST DU

DAS IST EVERDROP

Seit 2023 sind wir übrigens eine zertifizierte B Corp. Und mit deiner Hilfe wollen wir everdrop aufs nächste Level bringen. Schließ dich unserer Mission an – und hilf uns, einen nachhaltigen Lifestyle so einfach zu machen, dass er zum neuen Standard in unserer Gesellschaft wird.

jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description:
Quarzo Life construit une nouvelle génération de plateforme d’assurance vie combinant excellence opérationnelle, expérience utilisateur moderne et forte ambition technologique.

Après avoir construit notre MVP et posé les premiers standards engineering, nous renforçons aujourd’hui notre équipe technique interne autour de notre Founding Engineer / Lead Developer.

Nous recherchons un Senior Full Stack Engineer capable de prendre rapidement l’ownership de domaines fonctionnels importants de notre plateforme, d’accélérer le delivery produit et de contribuer directement à sa fiabilité en production.

Vous rejoindrez l’aventure à un moment clé : la base technique est déjà posée, le MVP est proche de sa mise en production et l’enjeu est désormais de faire évoluer rapidement la plateforme tout en renforçant sa robustesse, son observabilité, sa sécurité et sa maintenabilité.

Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec notre Founding Engineer / Lead Developer, qui porte la cohérence technique globale, l’architecture et la structuration progressive de l’équipe engineering, ainsi qu’avec Ferréol Robert, fondateur CPTO.

Votre rôle sera avant tout celui d’un builder avec un ownership de production : comprendre des problématiques métier complexes, concevoir des solutions simples et robustes, les développer de bout en bout, les mettre en production, puis vous assurer qu’elles fonctionnent correctement dans la durée.

Chez Quarzo Life, le travail d’un ingénieur ne s’arrête pas au merge d’une pull request : you build it, you run it.

Les compétences clés attendues incluent une solide culture technique full-stack, avec une capacité à intervenir efficacement sur plusieurs dimensions du produit (front, back, données, infrastructure et production) sans nécessairement être expert sur chacune.

Nous recherchons surtout un profil capable de prendre l’ownership d’un problème plutôt que d’exécuter une liste de tickets : comprendre le besoin, challenger la solution, construire, livrer, observer et améliorer.

Le rôle pourra évoluer avec la croissance de Quarzo Life vers davantage de responsabilités techniques selon les compétences et aspirations du candidat.

Vos missions

Product engineering & delivery

  • Concevoir et développer des fonctionnalités produit de bout en bout sur notre stack TypeScript et React.
  • Prendre progressivement l’ownership technique de plusieurs domaines fonctionnels de la plateforme.
  • Participer activement à la discovery produit et à la conception fonctionnelle.
  • Challenger les spécifications lorsque cela permet d’améliorer le produit, de réduire la complexité ou d’accélérer le delivery.
  • Livrer régulièrement des fonctionnalités utilisables en production avec un haut niveau d’autonomie.

Production, run & observabilité

La plateforme Quarzo Life porte des opérations financières et assurantielles critiques. Son exploitation quotidienne fait donc pleinement partie du rôle de l’équipe engineering. Vous participerez directement au run de la production et serez progressivement autonome sur l’exploitation des services dont vous avez la responsabilité.

Vous serez notamment amené à :

  • surveiller quotidiennement la santé des applications et services en production ;
  • analyser les logs, métriques, traces et alertes afin d’identifier rapidement les anomalies ;
  • construire et améliorer les dashboards permettant de suivre les principaux composants et flux de la plateforme ;
  • investiguer les incidents de production jusqu’à identification de leur cause racine ;
  • suivre le bon fonctionnement des principaux flux métier et techniques ;
  • participer aux déploiements et vérifier leur bon déroulement en production ;
  • contribuer aux procédures de rollback, reprise, sauvegarde et restauration ;
  • réaliser des root cause analyses et post-mortems lorsqu’un incident significatif survient ;
  • mettre en œuvre les actions correctrices permettant d’éviter la répétition des incidents ;
  • identifier les opérations manuelles fragiles ou répétitives et les automatiser ;
  • participer, à mesure que l’équipe grandit, à une organisation d’astreinte adaptée à la criticité du service.

L’objectif est que chaque Senior Engineer puisse progressivement opérer de manière autonome les services qu’il développe, sans faire du Lead Developer le point de passage systématique pour chaque incident.

Infrastructure, DevOps & reliability

Sans nécessairement être un spécialiste DevOps ou SRE, vous devez être à l’aise avec l’environnement dans lequel votre code fonctionne.

Vous contribuerez notamment à :

  • intervenir sur les pipelines CI/CD ;
  • contribuer aux pratiques Infrastructure as Code ;
  • comprendre les problématiques de networking applicatif, configuration, secrets et dépendances externes ;
  • suivre les bases de données ;
  • améliorer les procédures de déploiement et de recovery ;
  • contribuer aux sujets de continuité et reprise d’activité.

Le Founding Engineer / Lead Developer conserve la responsabilité de la cohérence globale de l’architecture et des standards de plateforme, mais chaque Senior Engineer porte la fiabilité opérationnelle de son périmètre.

Software craftsmanship & qualité

  • Adhérer et faire vivre aux valeurs de l'artisanat logiciel.
  • Produire un code lisible, testé, documenté et maintenable.
  • Contribuer à faire progresser collectivement la qualité du codebase.
  • Appliquer et enrichir les standards engineering : tests automatisés, CI/CD, documentation, observabilité et sécurité.
  • Identifier spontanément les zones de dette technique et proposer des améliorations proportionnées aux enjeux.
  • Utiliser les pratiques DDD, TDD et les principes de clean architecture, sans dogmatisme.
  • Concevoir les fonctionnalités en anticipant leur exploitation et leur diagnostic en production.
  • Considérer logs, métriques, alertes et gestion des erreurs comme faisant partie intégrante d’une fonctionnalité terminée.

Sécurité & conformité

En tant qu’assureur, Quarzo Life évolue dans un environnement particulièrement exigeant en matière de fiabilité, de sécurité et de traçabilité.

Vous contribuerez notamment à :

  • intégrer les principes de security et privacy by design dans les développements ;
  • renforcer la sécurité applicative et infrastructure ;
  • assurer la traçabilité des traitements et événements importants ;
  • participer aux chantiers techniques liés à notre trajectoire ISO 27001 ;
  • contribuer à la gestion des vulnérabilités et à la sécurisation des dépendances ;
  • prendre en compte les exigences de résilience et de continuité propres à une plateforme financière régulée.

AI-native engineering

Nous considérons les outils IA comme une nouvelle composante du métier de software engineer.

Nous attendons de nos développeurs qu’ils sachent utiliser intelligemment les assistants de développement et LLM pour accélérer leur travail tout en conservant une forte capacité de jugement sur l’architecture, le code produit et la sécurité.

Vous serez notamment amené à :

  • utiliser les outils d’AI-assisted development pour accélérer exploration, développement, tests, debugging et documentation ;
  • comprendre et challenger le code généré plutôt que de simplement l’accepter ;
  • identifier des usages IA pertinents dans notre produit et nos outils internes ;
  • contribuer à définir les bonnes pratiques de l’équipe autour de ces nouveaux outils.

Vos compétences

Expérience

  • Expérience significative en software engineering sur des produits réellement exploités en production.
  • Idéalement 5 années d’expérience ou plus, même si nous privilégions la profondeur technique et les réalisations concrètes au nombre d’années.
  • Expérience dans un environnement produit, startup ou scale-up appréciée.
  • Capacité démontrée à prendre l’ownership d’un domaine fonctionnel ou d’une partie significative d’un produit.
  • Expérience sur des systèmes comportant des problématiques métier, des workflows ou des intégrations complexes.
  • Expérience concrète de diagnostic et résolution d’incidents en production.
  • Habitude de travailler avec logs, métriques, monitoring et outils d’observabilité.
  • Expérience de systèmes nécessitant un niveau élevé de fiabilité et de qualité appréciée.

Une expérience préalable dans l’assurance ou les services financiers constitue un plus, mais n’est pas requise.

Compétences techniques

  • Connaissance des approches DDD, Architecture Hexagonale et TDD.
  • Excellente maîtrise de TypeScript et expérience backend type NodeJS.
  • Bonne expérience React et développement frontend moderne.
  • Très bonne maîtrise des principes de conception logicielle et des APIs.
  • Maîtrise des bases de données relationnelles et de la modélisation de données.
  • Expérience significative des tests automatisés et de la code review.
  • Bonne culture CI/CD.
  • Bonne maîtrise des principes de monitoring, logging et observabilité.
  • Capacité à diagnostiquer un système distribué à partir de logs, métriques et traces.
  • Bonne compréhension des environnements cloud et de l’infrastructure applicative.
  • Bonne compréhension des enjeux de performance, disponibilité, sauvegarde et reprise.
  • Sensibilité forte aux enjeux de sécurité applicative.
  • Bonne compréhension des usages IA / LLM appliqués au développement logiciel.

Nous recherchons un profil full-stack au sens produit et production : il n’est pas nécessaire d’être expert de chaque couche, mais vous devez être capable de comprendre une fonctionnalité depuis son interface utilisateur jusqu’à son fonctionnement en production et d’intervenir là où cela crée le plus de valeur.

Production mindset

  • mettre une fonctionnalité en production ne constitue pas la fin du travail ;
  • un développeur doit comprendre comment son code fonctionne réellement en production ;
  • consulter les logs ou investiguer une alerte fait partie du métier ;
  • une anomalie doit être comprise jusqu’à sa cause racine ;
  • une bonne architecture doit aussi être observable et exploitable ;
  • automatiser une opération répétitive vaut généralement mieux que rédiger une longue procédure ;
  • l’incident de production est une source d’apprentissage permettant d’améliorer le système plutôt qu’un simple problème à faire disparaître.

Qualités personnelles

  • Humilité technique et envie de progresser avec une équipe exigeante.
    Forte capacité d’exécution.
  • Haut niveau d’autonomie et d’ownership.
  • Très bon jugement technique.
  • Capacité à prendre un problème jusqu’à sa résolution effective.
  • Pragmatique : capable d’arbitrer entre perfection technique et vitesse d’exécution.
  • Curieux et capable d’apprendre rapidement un métier complexe.
  • Sens produit développé.
  • Souci réel de la fiabilité et de la qualité opérationnelle.
  • Réflexe naturel d’investigation lorsqu’un comportement paraît anormal.
  • Communication claire, structurée et constructive.
  • Capacité à signaler rapidement un risque ou un incident plutôt qu’à attendre qu’il devienne critique.
  • Capacité à challenger une décision technique de manière argumentée tout en sachant s’aligner lorsqu’une décision est prise.
  • Goût pour les environnements entrepreneuriaux où beaucoup reste à construire.
  • Capacité à travailler efficacement avec un Lead Developer sans compétition de territoire.

Formation

  • Formation ingénieur, informatique ou équivalent.
  • Une expérience significative et démontrable sur des produits techniques complexes peut remplacer le critère de formation.

Langues

  • Français et anglais professionnel requis.
  • Une partie des interactions avec l’équipe technique et certains partenaires se déroulent en anglais.

Avantages

  • Un rôle de premier cercle de l’équipe engineering, avec un impact très direct sur la plateforme.
  • Une forte autonomie technique et produit.
  • Un véritable ownership de domaines fonctionnels et de leur exploitation en production.
  • Une proximité quotidienne avec le Founding Engineer / Lead Developer, le CPTO et les fondateurs.
  • Une plateforme encore suffisamment jeune pour pouvoir réellement influencer son architecture et ses standards.
  • Des problématiques techniques riches mêlant APIs, finance, assurance, systèmes transactionnels, sécurité, infrastructure et réglementation.
  • La possibilité de construire une culture engineering où product development et production ownership ne sont pas séparés artificiellement.
  • Une forte exposition aux enjeux de reliability, observability et scaling.
  • Un environnement entrepreneurial ambitieux avec des décisions rapides et peu de bureaucratie.

Si vous souhaitez construire une plateforme technologique ambitieuse avec un fort niveau d’exigence et un impact direct sur la croissance d’une entreprise en structuration, nous serons ravis d’échanger avec vous.

Le processus comprend plusieurs échanges techniques et stratégiques afin d’évaluer aussi bien les compétences techniques que l’alignement produit et business.

  • Anticipate organizational and delivery risks, and address them early through structured communication in complex, high-pressure customer environments.
  • Manage complex, critical systems, apply updates, and resolve incidents to keep them on track.
  • Plan and implement sophisticated (multi-)cloud or on-premises platforms.
  • Provide comprehensive support, tackle high-priority issues, and assist junior and professional team members in critical situations.

Requirements

Must-Have Hard Skills

  • Five to eight years of experience as a system engineer in cloud environments.
  • A strong DevOps background: CNCF and HashiCorp stacks, GitLab, Kubernetes, OpenShift, Helm, DevSecOps, IaC, and GitOps are your bread and butter.
  • Broad experience in software development, cloud migration, and platform engineering.
  • Strong networking skills and the ability to translate advanced concepts into smart network designs.

  • Expertise in improving automations and building new ones to enhance operations.
  • A sound understanding of how to align technology, architecture, and business requirements in complex customer environments.

Must-Have Soft Skills

  • You understand client needs, navigate demanding stakeholder situations with clarity and tact, and build strong, trust-based relationships.

  • Quality matters to you, and you take full responsibility for your work.
  • You work hands-on, support others in critical moments, and keep the right stakeholders aligned.

Nice-to-Have Qualifications

  • Proficiency in both written and spoken German.
  • GitLab, IBM (HashiCorp), Red Hat, and/or SUSE certifications.
  • Experience with SUSE products.
  • AWS, Azure, and/or GCP certifications.

Benefits

  • We're REALLY serious about Open Source. Keeping things transparent and accessible, supporting collaboration, and bigging up the community, it's not just what we do; it's who we are.

  • We're all about that growth mindset. Whether it's levelling up your skills, nabbing some new certs, or geeking out at conferences, we've got your back.

Distribution & outils

  • Piloter le channel management et la visibilité en ligne

Reporting & recommandations

  • Produire des analyses régulières et des reportings stratégiques

Contribution interne

  • Autonomie, rigueur et organisation
  • Capacité à convaincre et à argumenter

Avantages

CDI – Statut cadre
Un poste à fort impact avec une vraie autonomie

Travail sur des problématiques concrètes et variées

jobs.description:
Bei der AKSA Würenlos AG entwickeln und realisieren wir hochverfügbare Notstromlösungen – individuell, technisch anspruchsvoll und kritisch für unsere Kunden.

Wir suchen keinen klassischen Steuerungstechniker. Wir suchen eine Persönlichkeit, die komplexe Notstromanlagen als Gesamtsystem versteht, strukturiert und stabil zum Laufen bringt.

Wenn Sie nicht einfach programmieren, sondern Zusammenhänge erkennen, Ursachen verstehen und Verantwortung übernehmen, sind Sie bei uns richtig.

Aufgaben

Elektrokonstruktion

  • Konzeption und Erstellung komplexer Stromlaufpläne (eXs-CAD)

Automationsplanung

  • Technische Gesamtverantwortung für Steuerungslösungen in Projekten im Bereich Energie- und Notstromanlagen
  • Engineering und Umsetzung anspruchsvoller Steuerungskonzepte sowie Definition von technischen Standards
  • Integration von Notstromanlagen in übergeordnete Systeme (SPS, Leitsysteme, Gebäudeautomation)

Steuerungssysteme

  • Parametrierung und Inbetriebnahme von Generatorsteuerungen (z. B. ComAp, Cummins PCC) sowie übergeordneten Automationssystemen
  • Umsetzung und Optimierung von Netzersatz-, Synchronisations- und Lastmanagementfunktionen

Anlagentests und Inbetriebnahme

  • Durchführung und Leitung von FAT, SAT und Inbetriebnahmen im Werk sowie beim Kunden vor Ort
  • Analyse komplexer Störungen und Ableitung nachhaltiger Lösungen

Dokumentation und Standards

  • Sicherstellung einer sauberen, strukturierten und nachvollziehbaren Dokumentation
  • Aktive Weiterentwicklung und Standardisierung von Steuerungskonzepten, Engineering-Prozessen und Dokumentationen

Team und Zusammenarbeit

  • Fachliche Unterstützung und Coaching von jüngeren Steuerungstechniker:innen im Projektalltag

Qualifikation

  • Abgeschlossene Ausbildung im Bereich Elektrotechnik, Automation oder vergleichbar
  • Vorzugsweise Weiterbildung auf HF/FH-Stufe (z. B. Elektrotechnik, Energietechnik, Systemtechnik oder ähnlich)
  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Steuerungstechnik im industriellen Umfeld

  • Erfahrung mit SPS-Systemen und Automationslösungen
  • Wünschenswert, aber kein Must-have: Erfahrung mit Generatorsteuerungen wie ComAp, Cummins PCC oder vergleichbaren Systemen
  • Kenntnisse in der Integration von Anlagen und Systemen

  • Strukturierte, lösungsorientierte und selbstständige Arbeitsweise
  • Hohe Eigenverantwortung, Durchsetzungsfähigkeit und Qualitätsbewusstsein
  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse, Englisch von Vorteil

Was Dich auszeichnet

jobs.title: iOS Software Engineer
jobs.description:
About ActAI

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

Our product focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. We believe products will greatly reduce hallucinations.

Our objective is to organise anyone's life, allowing us all to spend time on valuable and meaningful things.

 

Role

As an iOS Software Engineer, you own the iOS client experience, how AI feels, responds, and performs in users’ hands. This is not a thin integration role. You will build a production-grade iOS application where AI interactions are central to product experience, and performance, reliability, and user trust are critical.

 

Focus

  • Build and maintain iOS applications using Swift and SwiftUI.

  • Integrate AI-powered features through backend APIs.

  • Design UX patterns for AI interactions, including loading states, streaming responses, retries, and fallbacks.

  • Optimize performance, memory usage, and battery efficiency.

  • Capture user signals and feedback to support AI evaluation and iteration.

  • Collaborate closely with backend and ML engineers on API design and system behavior.

  • Maintain high App Store quality, stability, and production reliability.

 

Ideal Experiences

  • 3+ years of iOS development experience using Swift.

  • Hands-on experience integrating AI-powered features into mobile apps.

  • Strong understanding of async/await, concurrency, and background tasks.

  • Solid iOS performance and memory optimization skills.

  • Experience shipping and maintaining production iOS apps.

  • Comfort designing for latency, partial failure, and non-deterministic AI behavior.

  • Exposure to CoreML or light on-device ML.

  • Familiarity with feature flags or remote configuration systems.

  • Strong intuition for AI UX patterns and user trust considerations.

 

Outcomes

  • Stable, smooth, and reliable real-world use iOS applications.

  • Performance is optimized: responsive, low-latency, and efficient on memory and CPU.

  • Production issues are detected early, monitored effectively, and resolved with clear root-cause analysis.

 

Tech Stack

  • Swift

  • SPM

  • SwiftUI

  • SQL / noSQL

  • TensorFlow Lite (on-device inference)

 

How We Work

The best products today in the world were built by small, world class teams. We are a high talent density and hands-on team. We make decisions collectively, move at rapid speed, striking a balance between shipping high quality work and learning. Joining our team requires the ability to bring structure, exercise judgment, and execute independently. Our goal is to put in hands of our users a truly magical product

 

Interview process

If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach to schedule 3, but no more than 4 interviews.

Applications are evaluated by our technical team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite.

We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us. This isn't just a job offer; it's an invitation to be part of a team that's bringing AI to have practical benefits to billions globally.

jobs.description:
Nous recherchons un-e Responsable de la Sécurité des Systèmes d'Information (RSSI) pour rejoindre l’UTC. En tant que RSSI, vous serez chargé-e de veiller à la sécurité et à l’intégrité des données de notre établissement.

Votre mission

Expert-e, vous contribuez à l’élaboration, au pilotage et à la mise en œuvre de la stratégie de sécurisation du système d’information.

Vous participez activement à l’accompagnement de la transformation numérique de l’établissement pour intégrer la sécurité au cœur de chaque projet.

Vos activités

Vous serez chargé-e de :

  • Définir en concertation, puis piloter en autonomie, le déploiement de la PSSI de l’établissement et la stratégie de mise en conformité des systèmes d’information en lien avec la gouvernance et son évolution cohérente ;

  • Mettre en place la démarche sécurité des systèmes d’information répondant aux exigences réglementaires, notamment NIS2 ;

  • Assurer le management de la sécurité de l’information dans une démarche d’amélioration continue et animer les équipes dans sa mise en œuvre ;

  • Élaborer les prescriptions sécuritaires en matière d’architecture cible en s’assurant de la cohérence des projets avec cette dernière ;

  • Développer une culture de la sécurité de l’information dans l’établissement ;

  • Procéder à l’analyse des risques, piloter ou effectuer des audits et contrôles en matière de sécurité de l’information ;

  • Analyser les résultats des scans de vulnérabilité et de conformité et mettre en œuvre des mesures correctives nécessaires ;

  • Assurer une veille technologique et réglementaire active pour adapter la stratégie de sécurité aux nouvelles menaces ;

  • Développer une expertise dans l’établissement et créer un réseau avec différents acteurs nationaux de la cybersécurité ;

  • Participer à l’urbanisation et aux initiatives de cartographie du SI ;

  • Accompagner la transformation numérique de l’établissement en intégrant la sécurité dès la conception des projets (security by design) ;

  • Piloter la gestion des incidents de sécurité et animer le plan de continuité d’activité (PCA) et le plan de reprise d’activité (PRA).

  

Établissement

Créée en 1972, l’Université de technologie de Compiègne (UTC) est un établissement public à caractère scientifique, culturel et professionnel (EPCSCP) sous le statut d’université de technologie, dont les missions principales sont : la formation d’ingénieurs et le développement de la recherche et de la technologie.

L’UTC est un modèle original reconnu dans le paysage de l’enseignement supérieur et de la recherche français qui conjugue les caractéristiques d’une université et d’une école d’ingénieurs. Elle se distingue par son approche interdisciplinaire, son ouverture sociétale et économique et une forte ouverture à l’international. L’UTC est membre fondateur du groupe UT, réunissant les universités de technologie de Troyes, Belfort-Montbéliard et de Tarbes Occitanie Pyrénées. L’UTC est également membre de l’alliance Sorbonne Université et de l’alliance européenne SUNRISE. L’UTC accueille 4 400 étudiants, dont 3 600 élèves ingénieurs, 760 collaborateurs et plus de 800 vacataires. Elle est dotée d’un budget de 74 000 000 € et bénéficie d’un patrimoine immobilier de 72 000 m² réparti en 40 bâtiments implantés sur deux campus compiégnois.

We develop our inspection technology entirely in-house: from ultrasonic measurement systems and FPGA signal processing to the software our analysts use to interpret hundreds of kilometres of pipeline data.

The inspection results our software produces are used for safety-critical decisions about the integrity of pipelines and industrial installations such as heat exchangers. Reliability and correctness are therefore not a nice-to-have, but an absolute requirement.

We operate across Europe, North America and the Middle East. Our software products sit at the heart of that work: they are used every day by our data analysis organisation around the world. Whatever you build here has a direct, global impact.

You will work hands-on on the C#/.NET software behind our data analysis, turning large volumes of ultrasonic inspection data into reliable insights that our organisation uses worldwide.

What makes it attractive is the mix. You mentor and guide our internal developers, setting an example in how we design, review and test. At the same time you work side by side with our external development partners. Learning from them, challenging them and making sure the work meets a high bar. You'll grow as an engineer and as a mentor, often in the same week.

Because our data is used for safety-critical decisions, a strong sense of software quality runs through the role: it shapes how you design, how you review and where you set the standard for the team. •      You contribute to test strategies at functional, integration and system level, with an eye for the safety-critical use of the software

Mentorship & working with partners

•      You help establish and document engineering standards: coding guidelines, review processes, testing strategies and release policy

•      You make sure design decisions and domain knowledge are documented and transferable, so the team can operate independently

•      You help shape a development culture where quality and continuous improvement are the norm


What you bring

Technical expertise

•      Extensive experience with C# and the .NET platform

•      Solid knowledge of software architecture, design principles and design patterns

jobs.title: Senior Integrity Engineer
jobs.description:
Senior Integrity Engineer

Europe | Remote (hybrid near an Intero office) | 32-40 hours

An inspection shows a client what is wrong. You show them what to do about it.

Are you the integrity engineer people turn to when the inspection data is in and a decision has to be made? Do you enjoy combining fracture mechanics, corrosion growth and sound engineering judgment into advice an operator can actually act on? Then we would like to meet you. We are growing our Integrity team and are looking for our first Senior Integrity Engineer based in Europe.

About Intero

Intero Integrity Services helps pipeline operators and industrial companies keep their assets safe, compliant and running. With our own in-line inspection technology (including MFL and UT) we inspect pipelines and installations all over the world and tell clients exactly what condition their assets are in. Headquartered in Tricht, the Netherlands, we have over 40 years of experience and 650+ professionals from 25+ nationalities.
Learn more about our Inspection service line in this video: Intero - The Power of Integrity.

Your team

You join a close-knit Integrity team of five, including you: a Principal Integrity Engineer and Team Lead in Vancouver, an Integrity Engineer in Mexico City and two Junior Integrity Engineers in Toronto and Calgary. The team is part of our Data Analysis (DA) department.

Together the team delivers integrity reports for clients around the globe. You will be in daily contact with your teammates. The atmosphere is informal, communication is clear and transparent, and the pace follows the workload: some weeks are calm, others are full on. As the first team member in Europe, you strengthen our coverage of European time zones and clients.

Why this role matters

An inspection delivers a list of findings. For our clients, especially in highly regulated markets, a list of problems without a solution is not enough. That is where you come in. The Integrity team turns inspection results into a complete solution package: assessments, remaining life, and clear recommendations that help operators make well-founded decisions about the continued operation of their systems. In this role you raise the quality and consistency of that package, review the work of junior engineers, and help develop the tools and methods the team relies on.

What your week looks like

Part of your week goes to performing integrity assessments on pipelines, piping, heaters and boilers. The other part goes to supporting business development, developing methods and giving technical support. From day one you will work on Corrosion Growth (CG) reports and Fitness-for-Service (FFS) assessments.

·        Perform Level 1 and Level 2 FFS assessments and advanced Corrosion Growth Analysis (CGA); review or prepare Level 3 FFS assessments where projects require it.

·        Review the work of junior engineers, such as Run Comparison reports, dent strain and bending strain analyses, against the applicable codes and standards.

·        Act as the technical point of contact for project managers and clients on structural integrity questions, and support proposals and client-facing technical activities.

·        Align recommendations with local and national regulations, and build knowledge of codes and standards across jurisdictions.

·        Validate and help develop our in-house engineering tools, and write Python or VBA scripts to automate evaluations based on MFL and UT inspection data.

·        Set up and maintain internal procedures, technical questionnaires and quality checklists so every deliverable meets client and internal standards.

·        Manage several projects at the same time, and flag risks and priorities early.

What you bring

Must-haves

·        A degree in Mechanical and/or Materials (or Metallurgical) Engineering, ideally a combination of both. A Master's degree is a strong plus.

·        At least 5 years of relevant experience in the structural integrity of pressurised equipment, preferably pipelines, including independently performing and reviewing FFS assessments and remaining life calculations.

·        Strong working knowledge of fracture mechanics and corrosion and fatigue damage mechanisms.

·        Working knowledge of API 579 / ASME FFS-1, API 530, ASME B31G, DNV-RP-F101, API 1183, ASME VIII Div. 2 and ASME PCC-2, and of the international regulations for pipeline and pressure equipment integrity.

·        Experience with risk assessments and turning results into clear, actionable recommendations.

·        Strong mathematics and statistics, including probabilistic methods.

·        Programming skills to solve engineering problems, preferably in Python, VBA or MATLAB.

·        Mid to advanced-level training in integrity assessment methods.

·        You write clear, professional technical reports and explain complex topics to both technical and non-technical audiences.

·        You work independently with minimal supervision, keep your agreements, and are flexible with working hours to collaborate with colleagues in Canada and Mexico.

·        You are curious, proactive and a team player who suggests improvements to help the team work better and avoid rework.

Nice-to-haves

·        Hands-on experience with finite element analysis (FEA), preferably ABAQUS.

·        Experience with creep assessment of boilers and heaters.

·        Exposure to Level 3 FFS assessments.

·        Experience with pipeline ILI data analysis (MFL/UT).

·        Experience with client-facing technical activities or proposals.

·        Experience in highly regulated industries.

Why Intero

·        Work that makes a difference. Your recommendations directly determine whether critical pipelines and installations can keep operating safely.

·        Variety. Pipelines, piping, heaters and boilers; FFS Level 1 to 3, corrosion growth, dent strain and more, for clients all over the world.

·        Real influence. You help shape the team's methods, procedures and in-house tools, and see your ideas put into practice.

·        International team, flexible set-up. Daily collaboration with colleagues in Canada and Mexico, remote working from Europe, and once or twice a year a visit to our HQ in Tricht.

·        Growth. Within one to three years you can take on a larger share of Run Comparison and FFS reviews and expand into dent strain analysis.

What we offer

·        A contract for 32-40 hours per week.

·        A competitive salary and benefits package, tailored to the country you're based in. Because pay and conditions vary by location, we'll discuss the details with you personally during the process.

·        Remote working from Europe, or hybrid if you live near one of our offices with available space.

·        Flexible start of the day between 6:00 and 10:00, with occasional early or late meetings to overlap with our North American team.


Application process

1. Introductory interview with our recruiter.
2. Technical interview with our Principal Integrity Engineer and Team Lead.
3. Final interview with Manager and Business Director.
4. Job offer.

Job Title: Project Manager - Software Implementation (m/f/x) 

Location: EU

(Remote) 

 

Who You’ll Work For: 

 

At Makersite, we're pioneering the future of sustainable product development and digital collaboration. As a leading platform for product lifecycle management (PLM), we empower companies to make smarter, more sustainable decisions across their entire supply chain. Our cutting-edge software enables teams to design, prototype, and manufacture with transparency, efficiency, and responsibility—reducing environmental impact while optimizing performance. 

We're a fast-growing, innovative company that thrives on creativity, collaboration, and continuous learning. If you're passionate about technology, sustainability, and creating meaningful impact, we’d love to hear from you. Join us and be a part of shaping the future of manufacturing and product innovation. 

 

Who we're looking for: 

 

As part of our growing team, you will play a key role in shaping the future of sustainable product development. We’re looking for innovative, driven Project Managers who are passionate about technology and sustainability to join us in building tools that enable companies to make smarter, more responsible decisions. In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to collaborate with talented professionals, contribute to cutting-edge projects, and help drive the digital transformation of industries worldwide. If you're ready to make an impact and contribute to meaningful change, we want to hear from you! 

This role is a fixed, permanent position. All successful applicants will receive a permanent employment contract regardless of location.  

 

The role:

  

  • Lead the planning and implementation of software projects related to system connections with our customers, ensuring they are delivered on time and within scope. 

  • Maintain and update project plans, proactively identifying and managing any project risks. 

  • Ensure the availability of the right expertise for each project phase, coordinating with internal and external resources as necessary. 

  • Manage stakeholder expectations, delivering regular and comprehensive project updates and effectively resolving any arising issues. 

  • Contribute to the standardization of project implementation methodology and project templates to improve project standardization and efficiency. 

  • Generate thorough Project/Solution Documentation, outlining project goals, deliverables, and timelines. 

  • Handle all customer communication across various projects, ensuring clear, consistent, and timely communication with all stakeholders. 


  • Master's degree in project management or related technical field required. 

  • Background in Electronics/Electricals

  • Professional Project Management Certification from an accredited institution preferred. 

  • Demonstrated understanding of Project Management processes, strategies, and methods 

  • Excellent time management and organizational skills and experience establishing guidelines in these areas for others. 

  • 3+ years of Project management experience in the field of software implementations 

  • Experience with complex data projects where a systematic approach is crucial to success. 

  • Dexterity with software tools and data manipulation & analysis 

  • A creative mind that can think outside the box. 

  • Curiosity to find disruptive as opposed to incremental solutions to challenging data problems. 

  • Residing in and legally permitted to work in the EU. 

 

What We Offer: 

 

  • Competitive Salary – We reward your skills and experience with a compensation package that reflects your value. 

  • 30 Days Paid Time Off – Take the time you need to recharge and maintain a healthy work-life balance. 

  • Remote-First Flexibility – Work from anywhere in the EU, with the option to collaborate in person at our offices in Stuttgart, Berlin (role dependent). 

  • Generous Learning & Development Budget – We invest in your growth, providing ample resources for personal and professional development. 

  • Choose Your Ideal Work Equipment – Whether you prefer Apple or Microsoft, we’ll equip you with the tools you need to excel. 

 

The Experience: 

 

  • Purpose-Driven Work – Build something meaningful. Here, you’re not just creating another app; you’re contributing to a transformative vision that you can be proud of. 

  • Great Colleagues – Join a team that’s open, transparent, and international. We value inclusivity and foster a culture of collaboration and mutual respect. 

  • Work-Life Balance – As a remote-first company, we trust you to do your best work, your way. You have the flexibility to work when it suits you, ensuring a healthy balance between personal and professional life. 

  • Pride in Impact – We're already making a significant difference with global, well-known customers who share our vision. Be part of something that matters. 

  • Stability with Ambition – With realistic growth plans, we’re committed to changing the way things are made—without sacrificing our ambitious goals for innovation and impact. 

If you want to find out more about what it’s like to work at Makersite, check out our Careers Page here

jobs.description:
We Want You to Grow With Us 

Intersnack is building a next-generation AI and data foundation and this role is at the heart of making that foundation meaningful for the people who rely on it every day. As our AI Engineer for Analytics & End-User Insights, you will bridge the gap between enterprise data architecture and the business users who depend on trustworthy, actionable intelligence to make decisions. You will report into the AI Programme and collaborate across procurement, manufacturing, and sales to deliver AI-powered reporting that business teams can understand, trust, and act on. 

What We Can Offer 

You will join a collaborative, internationally minded team building something genuinely new: a modern, AI-grounded analytics capability that complements existing reporting and serves real business decisions. This role offers significant autonomy to shape how AI is introduced into the daily workflows of colleagues across multiple functions and countries. The impact of your work will be visible and measurable, from the moment a business user receives an AI-generated insight they trust, to the gradual reduction of manual reporting steps that once dominated their week. Dusseldorf serves as your home base, with flexibility for remote working, and the broader Intersnack network gives you exposure to a truly international operating environment. 

How You Will Spend Your Time as Our Next AI Engineer - Analytics & End-User Insights 

You will operate at the intersection of data engineering, AI, and business enablement: designing the data supply chain and semantic infrastructure that makes AI-driven analytics possible, while ensuring that the people who consume those analytics are equipped to use them with confidence. Your focus spans architecture and adoption in equal measure, working closely with business stakeholders to define what good looks like and then building the pipelines and models to get there.

  • Embed security-by-design principles into all analytics and AI assets, including protections against prompt injection, data leakage, and model misuse 

  • Collaborate across IT, data, security, and business functions to ensure analytics outputs are governed, compliant with EU AI Act and GDPR requirements, and aligned to Intersnack's data sovereignty standards 


Essential Skills & Experience 

  • Proven experience designing and implementing multi-layer data architectures, including landing zones, transformation layers, and consumption layers

  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Azure and/or AWS data and AI services (e.g., Azure Data Factory, Azure ML, AWS Glue, SageMaker, or equivalent)

Valuable Experience

  • Experience in FMCG, manufacturing, or procurement environments, with an understanding of the data and reporting challenges specific to these domains

jobs.title: Founding Product Builder
jobs.description:
If you think product management means writing tickets for engineers to execute, this role isn't for you.
If you think AI is a feature you bolt onto a roadmap after the fact, this role isn't for you either.

---

We believe AI doesn't create talent. It amplifies it.
Used poorly, it generates an exponential amount of technical debt.
Used well, it becomes a team of eager junior engineers capable of executing at machine speed.
The quality of the outcome depends on how well you organize them, guide them, and review their work.
---

We're building Lonio, an AI-native backoffice outsourcing service for finance & HR.
Most companies see AI as a product opportunity.
We do too.
But we believe the bigger opportunity lies in execution.
The companies that master AI-native engineering and product development will build faster, learn faster, and out-execute competitors still operating with traditional processes.
That's the company we're building.
This is not an AI product company. This is an AI-native service company.
Want to know how to build it? Watch this.
This is not a classical start-up, we are a spin-off out of BLP Digital, the fastest-growing AI scale-up in Europe.

Tasks

You should be excited by

  • Turning complex Swiss HR and payroll compliance logic into specs engineers can build from without gaps.
  • Owning the product roadmap for our compliance AI automation workflows
  • Working daily with engineering to scope work, sequence what ships next, and catch edge cases before they become technical debt.
  • Joining customer conversations when it sharpens the roadmap. This isn't a GTM role, but you'll sit in on discovery and demo calls often enough to know our customers' problems firsthand.

You'll work directly with Nick (CEO) to translate deep domain knowledge into a product Lauriane (CTO) can execute against.

Requirements

We're less interested in your credentials than your trajectory.
We don't have a predefined model of what a great product person looks like.

What matters to us is that you:

  • Understand what AI agents can and can't reliably do today
  • Write specs precise enough that an engineer builds from them without guessing at edge cases ;)
  • Have strong product fundamentals: prioritization, and turning ambiguity into a plan.
  • Learn fast in a regulated domain you likely don't know yet.
  • Take ownership, including the parts of the job nobody has defined yet.
  • Care about outcomes more than titles.
  • Are comfortable working shoulder to shoulder with engineers daily. This role doesn't stop at strategy and hand off execution.
  • Bonus: German fluency and comfort with Swiss B2B customers (CFOs, Treuhand firms, and payroll specialists), since you'll visit them from time to time.

Benefits

We're flexible on titles, backgrounds, and compensation structures.
If you're unsure whether you qualify, we'd still encourage you to apply.

A final note from the CTO.

Nick knows this domain cold. Swiss payroll compliance, the Treuhand ecosystem, what customers actually need. All of that is in his head.
The hard part is turning that knowledge into specs I can build from without guessing at the edge cases.
That gap is exactly what this role closes.
If you like being the translation layer between deep domain expertise and a small, fast-moving engineering team, you'll enjoy this.

jobs.title: Projekt & Operations Manager (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Du möchtest nicht nur einzelne Projekte koordinieren, sondern die operativen Abläufe eines innovativen Technologieunternehmens ganzheitlich mitgestalten? Du behältst auch bei mehreren parallelen Projekten den Überblick, erkennst Handlungsbedarf frühzeitig und entwickelst eigenständig Lösungen?

Unser Kunde entwickelt und fertigt autonome Drohnensysteme, Einsatzsoftware und spezialisierte Lösungen für Industrie, Netzbetreiber, Behörden und maritime Anwendungen. Dabei entstehen hochspezialisierte Systeme, die Hardware, Software und autonome Technologien miteinander verbinden und bereits bei namhaften Kunden zum Einsatz kommen.

Für die weitere Entwicklung des Unternehmens wird eine erfahrene Persönlichkeit gesucht, die das operative Tagesgeschäft übernimmt, Projekte und Ressourcen koordiniert und gemeinsam mit dem Geschäftsführer Strukturen für weiteres Wachstum schafft.

  • Attraktive Vergütung: Ein leistungsgerechtes Fixgehalt, das deiner Erfahrung und Qualifikation entspricht.

  • Gestaltungsspielraum: Übernimm eine zentrale Rolle beim Aufbau und der Weiterentwicklung der operativen Strukturen und Prozesse.

  • Entwicklungsperspektive: Die Position bietet langfristig die Möglichkeit, sich zu einer zentralen Führungsrolle im Bereich Operations weiterzuentwickeln.

  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit: Kurze Entscheidungswege und enger Austausch mit dem Geschäftsführer.

  • Technologieumfeld: Arbeite an innovativen Drohnensystemen und autonomen Technologien mit anspruchsvollen Anwendungen.

  • Unternehmenskultur: Flache Strukturen, offene Kommunikation und ein motiviertes Team mit hoher Technikaffinität.

  • Mobiles Arbeiten: Homeoffice ist nach Absprache möglich, sofern es die jeweiligen Aufgaben und die operative Situation erlauben.

  • Arbeitsumfeld: Moderne Ausstattung mit aktueller Hard und Software sowie kurze Wege zwischen Entwicklung, Produktion und Projektmanagement.

  • Teamspirit: Regelmäßige gemeinsame Aktivitäten und Teamevents sorgen für ein persönliches und unkompliziertes Miteinander.

  • Individuelle Benefits: Persönliche Wünsche und Vorschläge sind willkommen. Gemeinsam werden individuelle Benefits erarbeitet.

Deine Aufgaben

Als Projekt & Operations Managerübernimmst du eine zentrale Rolle im operativen Tagesgeschäft und sorgst dafür, dass Projekte, Ressourcen und interne Abläufe zuverlässig ineinandergreifen.

  • Operative Steuerung: Koordination des täglichen Geschäftsbetriebs über die Bereiche Werkstatt, Produktion, Entwicklung, Projektkoordination, Beschaffung und Flugbetrieb hinweg.

  • Projektkoordination: Steuerung mehrerer paralleler Entwicklungs-, Liefer- und Forschungsprojekte hinsichtlich Terminen, Ressourcen, Qualität und Budgets.

  • Priorisierung: Wöchentliche Abstimmung der Projektprioritäten, Kapazitäten und Ressourcen sowie eigenständige Lösung entstehender Konflikte.

  • Produktion: Koordination von Produktion, Ausgangsprüfung und Auslieferung der Drohnensysteme.

  • Prozesse: Aufbau und Weiterentwicklung effizienter operativer Abläufe in Bereichen wie Projektplanung, Aufgabensteuerung, Einkauf, Lager und Qualitätsmanagement.

  • Schnittstellenmanagement: Enge Abstimmung mit den Verantwortlichen aus Entwicklung, Produktion, Projektmanagement und weiteren internen Bereichen.

  • Projektmanagement: Unterstützung und Koordination bei Kundenprojekten, Lieferungen, Abnahmen und weiteren operativen Vorhaben.

  • Compliance: Koordination relevanter Themen rund um Exportkontrolle, Zoll und erforderliche Dokumentationen.

  • Geschäftsführung: Entlastung des Geschäftsführers im operativen Tagesgeschäft, damit dieser sich stärker auf Strategie, Technologie und Schlüsselkunden konzentrieren kann.

  • Weiterentwicklung: Erkennen von Verbesserungspotenzialen und eigenständiges Vorantreiben von Maßnahmen zur Skalierung und Automatisierung der operativen Abläufe.

Dein Profil als Projekt & Operations Manager

  • Mindestens fünf Jahre Erfahrung im Projektmanagement, Operations Management oder in einer vergleichbaren verantwortungsvollen Position mit technischen Produkten.

  • Ein abgeschlossenes technisches Studium, beispielsweise in Maschinenbau, Elektrotechnik, Mechatronik, Luft- und Raumfahrttechnik oder Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.

  • Erfahrung mit technischen Produkten, die Entwicklung und Fertigung verbinden, idealerweise in einem Umfeld mit eigener Produktion.

  • Mindestens zwei Jahre Erfahrung in einer verantwortungsvollen Rolle mit Führungsbezug oder der Steuerung von Teams und Projekten.

  • Erfahrung in der Koordination mehrerer paralleler Projekte sowie ein gutes Verständnis für Termine, Ressourcen, Budgets und Prioritäten.

  • Technisches Verständnis für mechatronische Systeme und die Fähigkeit, sich auf Augenhöhe mit Konstruktion, Elektronik und Software auszutauschen.

  • Eine ausgeprägte Eigeninitiative und die Fähigkeit, Probleme frühzeitig zu erkennen, selbstständig Lösungen zu entwickeln und Themen ohne lange Abstimmungswege voranzutreiben.

  • Eine ausgeprägte Hands on Mentalität und die Bereitschaft, in einem kleinen Unternehmen ohne große Stabstrukturen selbst Verantwortung zu übernehmen.

  • Fließende Deutschkenntnisse und gute Englischkenntnisse.

  • Bereitschaft zur Arbeit vor Ort sowie gelegentliche Reisebereitschaft für Kunden, Testkampagnen, Übungen und Messen. Diese Einsätze halten sich in der Regel in Grenzen und finden maximal etwa einmal pro Monat statt.

  • Erfahrung im Verteidigungs-, Marine-, Luftfahrt- oder Behördenumfeld.

  • Kenntnisse im Bereich Drohnen oder unbemannte Systeme.

  • Erfahrung mit Exportkontrolle, BAFA oder Zoll.

Die Position bietet die Möglichkeit, sich langfristig zu einer zentralen Führungsrolle im Unternehmen zu entwickeln. Du arbeitest direkt mit dem Geschäftsführer zusammen, hast einen umfassenden Einblick in die verschiedenen Unternehmensbereiche und kannst die operativen Strukturen maßgeblich mitgestalten.

(Hinweis: Du musst noch nicht in jedem einzelnen Punkt jahrelange Erfahrung haben – viel wichtiger ist uns deine Begeisterung, dich in neue Themen einzuarbeiten und gemeinsam mit uns zu wachsen!)

This role can be office-based in Freiburg, Germany or remote-first, with a requirement to be in the office one full week per month.

About Black Forest Labs

We’re the team behind Latent Diffusion, Stable Diffusion, and FLUX—foundational technologies that changed how the world creates images and video. We’re creating the generative models that power how people make images and video—tools used by millions of creators, developers, and businesses worldwide. Our FLUX models are among the most advanced in the world, and we’re just getting started.

Headquartered in Freiburg, Germany with a growing presence in San Francisco, we’re scaling fast while staying true to what makes us different: research excellence, open science, and building technology that expands human creativity.

Why This Role

Our models are already seeing strong inbound demand, and we’re expanding our commercial team to accelerate adoption across enterprise and strategic partners.

We’re looking for someone who can translate deep technical interest into durable, long-term partnerships  especially across complex, non-standard engagements involving APIs, on-prem deployments, and custom licensing.

This role owns the end-to-end commercial journey, working closely with research, engineering, and leadership to help customers move confidently from evaluation to production.

What You’ll Work On

  • Own the full sales cycle from discovery through close and expansion across startups, scaleups, and enterprises

  • Run complex, multi-stakeholder deals involving technical buyers, executives, and legal teams

  • Design and execute sales motions across APIs, on-prem deployments, and custom licensing

  • Build durable customer relationships that drive retention and long-term expansion

  • Partner closely with solutions engineering, forward-deployed engineers, product, research, and legal on bespoke deals

  • Translate customer needs and market signals into actionable feedback for product and research

  • Help define early commercial processes, playbooks, and qualification frameworks as we scale

What We’re Looking For

You’ve closed real, technically complex B2B deals and know how to operate without a playbook.

You bring strong judgment navigating long sales cycles, highly competitive environments with ambiguous requirements, and evolving products, and you’re comfortable working cross-functionally to get deals done the right way, not just quickly.

You'll likely have:

  • Experience selling technical products to tech executives, ML teams, and enterprise stakeholders

  • Ability to discuss model capabilities, inference requirements, and integration tradeoffs with technical buyers

  • Proven success managing long, multi-stakeholder sales cycles and closing strategic landmark deals

  • Strong negotiation skills across pricing, licensing, and custom commercial terms

  • Track record building and scaling pipelines across different deal sizes and customer types

  • Comfort shaping process and structure in fast-moving, early-stage environments

How We Work Together

We’re a distributed team with real offices that people actually use. Depending on your role, you’ll either join us in Freiburg or SF at least 2 days a week (or one full week every other week), or work remotely with a monthly in-person week to stay connected. We’ll cover reasonable travel costs to make this possible. We think in-person time matters, and we’ve structured things to make it accessible to all. We’ll discuss what this will look like for the role during our interview process.

Everything we do is grounded in four values:

  • Obsessed. We are a frontier research lab. The science has to be right, the understanding deep, the product beautiful.

  • Low Ego. The work speaks. The best idea wins, no matter who said it. Credit is shared. Nobody is above any task.

  • Bold. We take the ambitious bet. We ship, we do not wait for conditions to be perfect.

  • Kind. People over politics. We treat each other with genuine warmth. Agency without empathy creates chaos.

If this sounds like work you’d enjoy, we’d love to hear from you.

EU €150,000 - €185,000 + variable + equity

US $180,000 - $210,000 USD + variable + equity

jobs.title: SoC Architect
jobs.description:
Join our cutting-edge start-up adventure!

Who are we?

Join the Revolution in GNSS and IoT Connectivity

At Qualinx, we’re not just building chips, we’re engineering the future fabric of the connected world. As a pioneering semiconductor scale-up, we’re transforming how devices connect, communicate, and operate through our ground-breaking Digital RF technology. Our mission goes beyond ultra-low power GNSS: we’re redefining what’s possible in adaptive, scalable, and intelligent connectivity for the Internet of Things.

Born from deep-tech innovation at TU Delft, our team of visionary engineers and bold thinkers is tackling the toughest challenges in GNSS and IoT, starting with power consumption and expanding into dynamic, context-aware solutions that adapt to any environment or use case. We’ve already achieved what many thought impossible: the world’s most advanced GNSS chipset. But that’s just the beginning.

At Qualinx, we believe that the future of connectivity lies in precision, efficiency, and adaptability. Our ambition is to become the invisible thread that seamlessly interconnects billions of devices: powering a smarter, more responsive world.

What Sets Us Apart

Joining Qualinx is about becoming part of a culture that’s as ambitious as it is authentic. We hold ourselves to high standards, thrive on solving the unexpected, and push boundaries together. But we also know how to enjoy the ride. Our culture is a unique blend of curiosity, team spirit, and a touch of unconventional charm. It’s fast-paced, fun, and grounded in a sober sense of purpose and perspective. Whether we’re deep in design reviews or sharing laughs over lunch, we’re building something meaningful together. At Qualinx, you’re not just contributing to a ground-breaking technology, you’re helping shape a team that’s redefining what it means to work in deep tech.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities

  • System Design & Integration: You will be responsible for defining the high-level architecture of the SoC, determining which components will be included on the chip.

  • You will collaborate with the hardware design teams to guide the implementation of the chip's physical design.

  • You will coordinate with our firmware & GNSS team to ensure the SoC Architecture supports efficient execution of software, including drivers, operating systems and applications.

  • You will define and implement security features to protect the SoC from vulnerabilities.

  • You will keep up with the advances in the semiconductor industry and make sure the SoC architecture remains scalable and adaptable for future generations of products.

  • Managing product timelines and deliverables, making sure that the SoC Development follows the planned schedule and stays within budget.


Requirements

Qualinx is looking for a result-driven and conscientious senior SoC Architect. Someone who thrives in an environment where your proactive and can-do attitude is highly appreciated. The ideal candidate for this role must have:

  • Minimum of 12 years experience in RTL Design, RTL Verification, CPU-based Chip/Components Concepts and Architecture.

  • Deep understanding of ARM MCUs Subsystems, Memory Controllers, and memory architectures (e.g., SRAM, ROM, Flash, NVMe…).

  • At least 10 years’ experience with the Digital ASIC Flows, RTL design, Design Verification, Debug and Trace methodologies, Test (e.g., DFT, JTAG, Scan, BIST).

  • Solid understanding of chip packaging.

  • Proficient in hardware-software interface design, including device drivers, firmware, and low-level software optimizations.

  • Strong problem-solving skills to troubleshoot and resolve architectural issues related to SoC integration, performance, and power efficiency.

  • Experienced with silicon bring-up, validation, and post-silicon debug methodologies.

  • Practical experience with IP integration, including integration flows, interconnect design (e.g., AMBA, AXI, AHB), and managing key IP integration architecture tasks.

  • Deep understanding of peripherals, Pin Function Assignment, and multiplexing, as well as familiarity with various communication protocols (e.g. MIPI, LVDS, SPI, I2C, UART).

  • Experience in analog-digital interface design, including RF and Analog components like PLL, ADC, DAC, LNA, PA, DCDC, LDO… integration, and layout constraints for minimizing noise and signal interference.

  • Knowledge of low-power design techniques, including clock gating, power gating, and multi-voltage domains (UPF/CPF).

  • Deep understanding of library selection and design, with a focus on leakage power-aware methodologies to optimize performance and power trade-offs.

  • Hands-on experience with IP selection to meet the specific needs of the design.

  • Strong experience in selecting appropriate I/O technologies and designing for signal integrity, noise resilience, and power efficiency.

  • Strong knowledge of pad ring placement and ESD strategy.

  • In-depth expertise in clock and reset architecture design, including low-jitter clock distribution networks, clock domain crossing issues, and reset synchronization.

  • Solid understanding of power management units and implementing various power sequencing schemes, including wake, sleep, and deep sleep modes for power efficiency.

  • Solid Knowledge in signal processing, communication system.

  • Exposure to all aspects of RFIC system design.

What's in it for you?

At Qualinx, we believe that great work starts with a great environment, pioneering technology and a fun dynamic market to address. Here’s what you can expect when you join our team:

  • Ownership and Impact: We offer employee equity, giving you the opportunity to share in the success you help create.

  • Well-being Matters: Your physical and mental health are important to us. We provide access to wellness resources, including company discounts and a free mental healthcare platform.

  • Global Talent, Local Support: If you're relocating from abroad, we provide full support throughout the visa process to ensure a smooth transition.

  • Future-Focused Benefits: We contribute to your pension savings to help you plan ahead with confidence.

  • Inspiring Workspace: Work from a modern and vibrant, well-equipped office designed to help you do your best work.

  • Scale-up Team Spirit: We celebrate our wins together with fun quarterly events—think great food, games, and unforgettable experiences.

jobs.title: Senior Engineer Elektrotechniek
jobs.description:
Ben jij een ervaren Senior Engineer Elektrotechniek die impact wil maken in uitdagende Life Sciences-projecten? Ontwerp geavanceerde, duurzame installaties voor high-tech laboratoria, waar jouw expertise écht het verschil maakt. Bij Deerns krijg je de ruimte om complexe projecten te leiden en mee te bouwen aan de toekomst van wetenschap en gezondheidszorg.

 

De uitdaging 

Als Senior Engineer Elektrotechniek binnen de Life Sciences speel je een sleutelrol in het ontwerp van complexe en technisch productiefaciliteiten, zoals laboratoria. Jij vertaalt klantwensen naar betrouwbare, duurzame en toekomstbestendige elektrotechnische installaties, van energievoorziening tot communicatie- en beveiligingssystemen.

Vanaf de conceptfase denk je mee over technische oplossingen die voldoen aan de strengste normen. Je werkt nauw samen met andere disciplines in multidisciplinaire projectteams en bewaakt de kwaliteit en samenhang binnen het ontwerp. Dankzij jouw ervaring stuur je waar nodig bij en ondersteun je collega’s in hun ontwikkeling. In de rol van Senior Engineer neem je bovendien de volledige ontwerpverantwoordelijkheid op je en fungeer je als aanspreekpunt voor zowel klant als ontwerpteam

Tot je verantwoordelijkheden behoren:

  • Meedenken in de vroege ontwerp- en conceptfase van projecten, zoals laboratoria of productiefaciliteiten.

  • Uitwerken van elektrotechnische installaties op het gebied van o.a. energievoorziening, verlichting, brandveiligheid, zwakstroom-, beveiligings- en communicatievoorzieningen.

  • Opstellen van kabel- en lichtberekeningen met behulp van gespecialiseerde software.

  • Afstemmen en coördineren van ontwerpwerkzaamheden met de ontwerpleider en andere disciplines.

  • Ondersteunen van de ontwerpleider en projectmanager in de communicatie met klanten en partners.

 

Hier is waar 

  • We hebben gewerkt aan de ontwikkeling en het ontwerp van een duurzaam en modern gebouw voor het Nederlands Instituut voor Ruimteonderzoek (SRON), dat meetinstrumenten voor satellieten ontwikkelt. SRON verhuisde naar het Leiden BioScience Park en stelde hoge eisen aan het nieuwe gebouw op het gebied van duurzaamheid, cleanrooms en installatietechniek. Als onderzoeksinstituut gewijd aan het bestuderen van de aardatmosfeer vond SRON het belangrijk om de impact op natuur en milieu te minimaliseren. Je stuurt het integrale kostenmanagementproces aan en zorgt met betrouwbare en transparante kosteninformatie voor onderbouwde besluitvorming.
