jobs.title: Senior Electrical Engineer
jobs.description:
Heb jij diepgaande ervaring in elektrotechnische installaties en wil je bijdragen aan de meest kritische en innovatieve datacenterprojecten van dit moment? Als Senior Electrical Engineer Datacenters bij Deerns werk je aan high‑tech, schaalbare en energie‑efficiënte faciliteiten die de digitale wereld draaiend houden. Jij ontwerpt de elektrotechnische systemen die maximale betrouwbaarheid, veiligheid en continuïteit waarborgen precies waar de datacentersector om vraagt. 

 

De uitdaging 

Als Senior Electrical Engineer binnen onze Datacenter-afdeling ben je verantwoordelijk voor het ontwerp, de engineering en de technische coördinatie van complexe elektrotechnische installaties. Denk aan middenspannings- en laagspanningsverdelers, UPS‑systemen, generatoren, noodstroomconcepten, earthing & bonding, automatisering, beveiligingssystemen, energieopwekking en power monitoring die 24/7 betrouwbaar moeten functioneren. 

Vanaf de eerste conceptfase denk je mee over technische strategieën en ontwerpkeuzes die aansluiten op schaalbaarheid, energie‑efficiëntie, beschikbaarheidsnormen (Tier III/IV) en steeds strengere duurzaamheidsdoelstellingen. Je werkt intensief samen met disciplines zoals werktuigbouwkunde, bouwkunde en security en bewaakt de technische samenhang van het integrale ontwerp. Dankzij jouw senioriteit fungeer je als inhoudelijk aanspreekpunt voor klanten, ontwerpteams en leveranciers. Je stuurt waar nodig bij, begeleidt junior en medior engineers en draagt actief bij aan kennisontwikkeling binnen het datacenterteam. 

 

Tot je verantwoordelijkheden behoren: 

  • Ontwerpen van elektrotechnische systemen, waaronder laag- en middenspanning, UPS‑installaties, generatoren, beveiligingsinstallaties, kabelinfrastructuur en power monitoring. 

  • Meedenken in concept- en ontwerpfases en klantwensen vertalen naar haalbare, schaalbare E‑concepten. 

  • Coördineren van ontwerpactiviteiten met andere disciplines en bewaken van planning, kwaliteit en integraliteit. 

  • Fungeren als technisch aanspreekpunt voor klanten, partners, leveranciers en interne stakeholders. 

  • Begeleiden van junior en medior engineers binnen projecten en bijdragen aan kennisontwikkeling in het team. 

  • Ondersteunen bij aanbestedingen, kostenramingen, risicobeoordelingen en technische kwaliteitscontroles. 

Waar werken we aan

We hebben meegewerkt aan de bouw van diverse nieuwe datacenters in o.a. Milaan, Amsterdam. We hebben ondersteuning geboden bij het ontwerp van de mechanische, elektrische en sanitaire installaties voor de bouw. Na het ontwerp van de mechanische, elektrische en sanitaire installaties heeft Deerns toezicht gehouden op de bouwplaats om de kwaliteit van de installaties te controleren en heeft het als Commissioning manager voor de hoofdaannemer gefungeerd. Deerns heeft ook ondersteuning geboden bij de bouw om een Leadership in Energy and Environmental Design (LEED)-certificering te behalen. LEED-certificering betekent dat een gebouw gezond en zeer efficiënt is en betere milieuprestaties levert.

Het team 

Je maakt onderdeel uit van een team met circa 16 collega’s, binnen de bredere organisatie waarin je meer dan 750 collega's in verschillende sectoren zal hebben. Het Data Center team is een hecht team dat bestaat uit projectmanagers, adviseurs, mechanical- en electrical engineers. De cultuur is open, kennis gedreven en gericht op samenwerking en plezier in het werk. Bovendien werk je in een hecht, integraal projectteam waarin ieders kennis en expertise optimaal wordt benut. Dit zorgt niet alleen voor sterke samenwerking, maar ook voor persoonlijke groei. De unit Datacenters werkt voornamelijk in opdracht van Colocattie providers, banken en grote bedrijven, zowel in Nederland als internationaal. Dit zorgt ervoor dat je aan gevarieerde projecten werkt en geen dag hetzelfde is. Daarnaast werk je regelmatig samen met onze units in Engeland, Spanje en Brazilie  waardoor je onderdeel bent van een sterk internationaal netwerk.



Dit ben jij 

  • Een afgeronde hbo- of wo‑opleiding Elektrotechniek of een vergelijkbare richting. 

  • Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring als Electrical Engineer binnen complexe gebouwgebonden installaties; ervaring in datacenters of mission‑critical omgevingen is een sterke pré. 

  • Ervaring met multidisciplinaire projectomgevingen. 

  • Uitstekende beheersing van Nederlands en Engels, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk. 

  • Ervaring met MS Office, Revit, BIM360 en relevante E‑tools (zoals kabelberekeningen, selectiviteitsstudies, load flow en kortsluitberekeningen). 

  • Analytisch sterk, technisch nieuwsgierig en in staat om te schakelen tussen details en totaaloverzicht. 

  • Communicatief vaardig en comfortabel in een rol waarin techniek, kwaliteit en klantcontact samenkomen. 

 

Dit bieden wij 

  • Een functie van 32-40 uur per week met een bijpassend salaris. 

  • Uitdagende projecten voor toonaangevende opdrachtgevers in Nederland en internationaal. 

  • Een werkomgeving waarin innovatie en duurzaamheid dagelijks in de praktijk worden gebracht. 

  • Aandacht voor jouw eigen ontwikkeling en vitaliteit met ruime opleidings- en ontwikkelingsmogelijkheden, fiets- en sportregelingen, flexibele werkuren, 33 vakantiedagen en mogelijkheid tot aankopen van extra dagen. 

  • Hybride werken, waarbij je de mogelijkheid hebt om afwisselend thuis en op kantoor in Den Haag te werken. 

  • Een team waar samenwerking en collegialiteit voorop staan en waar we informeel met elkaar omgaan. 

  • Duurzaamheid zit in onze genen. Dit uit zich bijvoorbeeld in een mobiliteitsbeleid waar gezondheid en duurzaamheid voorop staan. Veel van onze kantoren liggen bij OV-knooppunten, fietsen wordt aangemoedigd en je reiskosten worden 100% vergoed op basis van OV. 

 

Over Deerns 
Deerns is als onafhankelijk ingenieursbureau gespecialiseerd in advies, ontwerp en uitvoeringsbegeleiding op het vlak van installatietechniek, bouwfysica, energievoorziening en duurzaamheid. Onze expertises dragen bij aan duurzame, intelligente en toekomstbestendige gebouwen die de processen van onze opdrachtgevers optimaal ondersteunen. We zijn verantwoordelijk voor het ontwerp van de installaties en het realiseren van een goed comfort en een prettig klimaat in de meest uiteenlopende gebouwen; van kantoren, tot luchthavens en van ziekenhuizen tot datacenters.

jobs.description:

Samen met multidisciplinaire projectteams geef je richting aan ontwerp en realisatie, met directe invloed op de dagelijkse operatie én de toekomstbestendigheid van luchthavens. Met jouw expertise en leiderschap til je niet alleen projecten, maar ook collega’s naar een hoger niveau.

Tot je verantwoordelijkheden behoren:

  • Het actief bijdragen aan kennisdeling en kwaliteitsverbetering binnen de afdeling Airports.

De projecten waar je trots op kunt zijn

  • We werken aan het verduurzamen van Terminal 1 & 2 van Schiphol, zo’n 40% van de gehele terminal: De huidige installaties die zorgen voor een aangenaam binnenklimaat, maken gebruik van fossiele brandstoffen. Wij werken aan het ontwerp van de nieuwe installatie, die warmte en koude opslag combineert met warmtepompen zodat Schiphol energieneutraal de toekomst tegemoet kan. De uitdaging van dit project zit met name in het toepassen van nieuwe techniek in een bestaand gebouw waar ruimte moet worden gecreëerd om alle apparatuur en leidingen goed onder te brengen en te zorgen dat elke ruimte wordt voorzien van voldoende verwarming en koeling. Dit moet zorgen voor een aangename passagiersbeleving maar ook voor het aanbieden van een prettig werkklimaat voor de medewerkers op Schiphol, rekening houdend met hun dagelijkse activiteiten.

  • We werken aan het nieuwe operationele gebouw van DC ANSP, de luchtverkeersleiding van het Nederlandse luchtruim in de Cariben. Dit is een faciliteit voor de luchtverkeersleiders die verantwoordelijk zijn voor area control, waarbij de operations room en de ruimte waar de apparatuur staat opgesteld aan strenge bouwfysische en klimaateisen moeten voldoen met een hoge mate van redundantie. De omgeving vraagt daarnaast om een robuust ontwerp dat bestand is tegen orkanen en aardbevingen.

  • We werken op Schiphol aan diverse grote en kleine projecten waarin klimaatbeheersing een grote rol speelt door intensiever gebruik van diverse ruimtes en toename van de apparatuur. Schiphol is een unieke klant om voor te werken, vanwege de omvang van de luchthaven, de continue operationele eisen en de aanwezigheid van verschillende beveiligingszones. Wij worden veel ingezet om de oorzaak van klachten te achterhalen en de juiste oplossing te bieden, of om de juiste oplossing te vinden voor nieuwe apparatuur die hogere eisen stelt aan de installaties. Vrijwel altijd gaat het hier om locaties waar zich passagiers bevinden en Schiphol deze een comfortabele omgeving wil bieden, of waar medewerkers taken uitvoeren die essentieel zijn voor het primaire proces van de luchthaven, waarbij een prettig klimaat een belangrijke voorwaarde is.

Je werkt in een team van collega’s binnen een organisatie met ruim 750 medewerkers, actief in verschillende sectoren. Het hechte airports team bestaat uit projectmanagers, adviseurs, mechanical- en electrical engineers en specialisten in airportsystemen. Er is veel kennis aanwezig over luchthavenoperaties, gebouwgebonden installaties en specifieke luchthavensystemen. De cultuur is open en gericht op het delen van kennis en werkplezier. Je maakt deel uit van een integraal projectteam waarin ieders expertise optimaal wordt benut, wat zorgt voor sterke samenwerking en persoonlijke groei. jobs.title: Product Engineer
jobs.description:
Bij Salland Engineering zoeken we een Product Engineer die een belangrijke rol speelt in het goed functioneren van onze pilot line en in de ondersteuning van het productieteam. In deze functie ben je de verbindende schakel tussen productie, engineering en klant.

Het team Product Engineering, onderdeel van de Semitest Group, wordt steeds belangrijker binnen Salland Engineering. Binnen deze omgeving ben je verantwoordelijk voor het vrijgeven van testoplossingen voor kwalificatie, karakterisatie en productie test. Daarnaast begeleid je kwalificatieruns in samenwerking met de klant, de planner en onze reliability partner.

Je werkt continu aan verbeteringen en streeft samen met je team naar efficiëntere processen en tooling. Storingen zie je niet als obstakel, maar als uitdaging. Je schakelt snel, denkt analytisch én praktisch en zorgt ervoor dat we optimaal blijven presteren. Je bent zichtbaar op de werkvloer en hebt veel contact met operators, teamleiders, engineeringcollega’s en de planner.

Een greep uit je werkzaamheden

  • Je beheert en evalueert kwalificatie- en betrouwbaarheidstesten, zoals HTOL, HAST en Temp Cycle;

  • Je analyseert testdata om prestaties, yield en betrouwbaarheid te beoordelen;

  • Je troubleshoot op device-, hardware- en softwareniveau en voert root cause analyses uit bij testafwijkingen, yield drops en product failures;

  • Je verleent technische ondersteuning aan productie- en testteams bij productissues en analyseert en lost device-, test- en procesafwijkingen op;

  • Je borgt soepele overgangen naar high volume manufacturing (HVM);

  • Je treedt op als technisch aanspreekpunt voor klanten en stemt technische verbeteringen af met leveranciers en externe testpartners;

Al meer dan 30 jaar ontwikkelen wij oplossingen en leveren wij diensten voor het testen van chips. Onze technologie vind je terug in alledaagse producten zoals smartphones, tablets en auto's. jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Do you want to work in a high tech environment where innovation is not a promise, but daily practice? At Salland Engineering, you work on technology for testing the chips of tomorrow. You will have access to state of the art tooling, modern test facilities and an environment where your own ideas, creativity and initiative are valued.

Salland Engineering is growing fast. This year, we are doubling our effective workspace, further expanding our testers and investing heavily in new technologies, including innovation in the field of photonics. As part of a global player in the semiconductor test market, we combine international strength with the freedom and short lines of communication of Salland in Zwolle.

As a Software Engineer, you develop C++ software, software calibration protocols and user interfaces for high tech electrical measuring instruments. These systems are used to test the most advanced chips behind the innovations of the future. This role is specifically focused on software development on the PC side.

Technical challenges do not put you off. On the contrary, you enjoy solving them and working closely together with your software, hardware and firmware colleagues to create smart and reliable solutions. Do you have a completed Bachelor’s degree in ICT, Software Engineering, Computer Science or Electrical Engineering and already have several years of work experience? Are you familiar with C++ software development and do you feel at home in PC side software development? Then it is good to know that this position is not focused on embedded software development. Does it suit you to show initiative and work together with other technical colleagues on highly innovative projects? Then we are looking for you.

What you will be doing in your role

  • Designing, implementing and verifying drivers (PC-based) for high-tech instruments in test solutions for ATE (Automatic Test Equipment);

  • Designing, implementing and verifying calibration protocols to ensure the accuracy of the instruments;

  • Writing automated tests for hardware validation and developing user interfaces;

  • Keeping information up to date;

  • You are responsible for your own planning and report to your project leader / scrum master.

Were will you work

Nice to meet you, we are Salland Engineering from Zwolle!

For more than 30 years, we have been developing solutions and providing services for testing chips. Our technology can be found in everyday products such as smartphones, tablets and cars. Together with around 95 colleagues, we work on innovative projects every day and serve the world’s largest manufacturers of chips and measuring instruments.

What will you get from us

A challenging job in a high-tech environment. We value taking initiative and taking responsibility, but there is more!

We offer:

  • An attractive salary, depending on your education and experience, between €3,866.22 and €5,523.18 gross per month (job scale: Engineer Expert B) based on a 40-hour workweek;

  • An environment where development is central. For us, it is essential to remain an interesting player in the market. That is why, as an employee at Salland Engineering, you are given all the space, opportunities and freedom to develop yourself, so we grow together;

  • A good work-life balance. We apply flexible working hours, giving you the room to arrange personal matters before or after working hours, meet with friends/family or go exercising.

  • Speaking of sports, you also receive a discount on your sports/fitness membership with us;

  • A collegial and informal company. We enjoy doing fun activities together and hope that you would like to be part of that.


What do we ask of you

  • A completed Bachelor’s degree in ICT, Software Engineering, Computer Science or Electrical Engineering;

  • At least 5 years of experience in programming C++ applications;

  • Affinity with hardware electronics and the ability to read and interpret electrical schematics;

  • Experience in working with oscilloscopes and other measuring equipment for testing and validating software functionality is a plus;

  • You have a good command of both Dutch and English;

  • You live in the Netherlands and within a maximum travel time of one hour from our office in Zwolle;

Senior AI Engineer
jobs.description:
Legal AI is only as good as the knowledge behind it. At Lefebvre Sdu, we’ve been building that knowledge for 200 years. Day in, day out. Law by law. Word by word. Other legal AI tools run on our data and software. As the Dutch heart of Lefebvre Group, the European leader in legal and tax knowledge, we’re also developing our own platform: GenIA-L, where lawyers and tax professionals don’t just get an answer, but an answer they’re willing to put their name to. More than 75,000 professionals use it every day, accounting for over €100 million ARR across Europe. We’re looking for a Senior AI Engineer to help shape how the intelligent core of that platform evolves.

HOW YOU'LL MOVE US FORWARD

GenIA-L is a research platform for legal professionals. A user asks a question. The platform searches our trusted sources and turns them into a usable answer. This is done with agents: specialised AI components that each take on part of the question and work together. In the legal domain, an answer can’t just sound convincing. It has to be correct, and you need to be able to see which source it comes from. This isn’t a pilot: the platform is in production and used heavily every day.

As a senior, you build alongside the team, but you also keep the bigger picture in view. You know the different parts of the platform and how they affect one another. You help prioritise, spot obstacles early and make sure we’re heading in the right direction, both in how we work and technically. You look ahead: where could we go, and what do we need to know to get there? And you help medior colleagues grow by seeing exactly where they’re stuck, without taking the work off their hands.

  • You give direction to the agent architecture of GenIA-L: which specialised agents are needed and how they work together.

  • You break down legal processes and translate them into technical solutions. You decide how the components are best connected.

  • You make sure our knowledge packages and the pipelines behind them can scale and stay up to date. A knowledge package is an expert-reviewed set of commentary, case law, legislative history and practical guidance for each article of law.

  • You build the way we measure quality. Using evaluation sets, observability and metrics, you show that answers, source attribution and reliability are genuinely improving. Not based on gut feeling, but on evidence.

  • You help prioritise the team’s work and flag technical or process risks early.

  • You explore new developments, test ideas in practice and turn them into proposals that make the product sharper or faster.

  • You coach medior engineers and work directly with editors and subject-matter experts.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

You have a realistic view of LLMs. You see what they can do, but you also know their weak spots. You follow new AI developments closely, but you don’t just follow the herd: you stay critical and aren’t afraid to say so. You can break a complex problem down into smaller pieces and keep oversight of a system with many moving parts. You take ownership, show initiative when things aren’t yet clear and think from the customer’s problem. You enjoy helping others move forward without taking over. And you like working with lawyers and editors, because they know what a good answer looks like.

  • Extensive experience in software or ML engineering, around 5 years or more. Depth in recent projects counts for more than the number of years.

  • In-depth knowledge of Python and experience with relevant machine learning libraries.

  • You’ve built LLM applications and run them in production.

  • Solid experience with agent frameworks such as LangGraph and LangChain, tool calling, MCP or similar orchestration. Our entire product is built around this. Experience with only a simple search-and-answer setup (RAG) isn’t enough.

  • You’ve made the quality of LLM systems measurable with evaluation sets and observability, and can give concrete examples. Experience with tools like MLflow and LiteLLM is a plus.

  • Strong backend experience, including REST APIs and Postgres databases.

  • Experience with Kubernetes.

  • Experience in the legal, tax or another knowledge-intensive domain is a plus.

WHAT YOU'RE SIGNING UP FOR

On Tuesdays and Thursdays, the team works together at the office. What colleagues value most here: mutual trust, room to experiment, and a team that helps each other out when someone gets stuck.

  • A place where you have influence from day one: on the approach, the processes, and the direction.

  • Colleagues who deliberately chose Lefebvre Sdu over big tech jobs because here, they're building something that doesn't exist yet.

  • Base salary between €5,500 and €6,450 per month, based on a 36-hour week, since that's full-time for us. Plus a lot of extra allowances (see below).

  • A bonus tied to company performance: a fixed year-end bonus of 4% and profit sharing of up to 6%.

  • 23 vacation days and a personal choice budget of 12%, of which 8% is holiday pay and 4% is freely allocable. Want more vacation? Just buy it.

  • A bonus of up to 10% of your salary, based on company performance and individual performance.

  • A solid pension plan through PGB, including supplementary partner insurance.

  • Collective insurance plans.

  • A travel allowance of €0.25 per kilometer or a public transport reimbursement, plus an attractive bike plan. For employees with a commute of less than 10 km or more than 60 km, we have an adjusted arrangement.

  • Two days a week in the office in The Hague, within walking distance of Voorburg station. The rest of the week, wherever you work best.

  • Room to grow: in your craft, in your role, in the organization.

Want to know more?

We’d love to tell you all about the team and the role. Send us your CV and you’ll hear from us within 5 working days. Any questions first? Message or call Nadine on 06 28556265.

A reference check and a VOG (certificate of good behaviour) are part of the selection process.

jobs.description:
Purpose of the job

The Director Research & Development (R&D) leads the exploration and development of potential business and technology initiatives, from initial ideation through feasibility analysis, testing, validation and proof of concept (POC)/prototyping. For assigned initiatives, the role coordinates the full exploration phase and develops substantiated proposals for consideration and approval by the relevant governance bodies.

 

The role requires a proactive, self-motivated approach, the ability to work independently and to manage multiple subjects concurrently. Initiatives may range from joint venture (JV) model enhancements and artificial intelligence (AI) to customer experience development and new approaches to distribution.

 

KEY RESULT AREAS/ KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 

Ideation and concept generation

  • Ensure that potential initiatives align with SkyTeam’s strategic goals and assess their purpose, expected value, rationale and the implications of not proceeding.
  • Ask relevant questions and gather appropriate information to support well-founded recommendations and help build consensus among member airlines.
  • Organize and facilitate ideation and brainstorming sessions.
  • Monitor developments in the transport industry and at IATA to identify emerging trends and opportunities or gaps for improving existing legacy systems.
  • Generate, collect and develop ideas and concepts in partnership with member airlines and other contributors for marketable initiatives that could become SkyTeam priorities.

 

Exploration, feasibility and concept development

  • Lead the exploration of assigned initiatives, including relevant research and data analysis, feasibility assessments, business cases, business requirements documents (BRDs) and POCs/prototypes, as appropriate.
  • Analyze business and technical challenges across different airline domains; identify and assess potential solutions and determine the most relevant product concept, design and feasibility approach.
  • Develop evidence-based recommendations, supported by tangible data and analysis, that demonstrate the potential business value of the proposed initiative.
  • Prepare proposals and supporting materials for review and approval by the relevant SkyTeam and member-airline decision-making bodies.

 

Stakeholder engagement and governance

  • Work effectively within SkyTeam’s matrix organization and collaborate with member airlines, internal teams and relevant external contributors.
  • Engage with operational and technical stakeholders, including senior decision-makers, to understand requirements, assess options and build alignment around proposed concepts.
  • Support informed decisions through clear analysis and recommendations. Strategic prioritization and formal initiative approval remain with the Executive Board (EB), Strategy Committee (StratCom) and relevant governance bodies.

 

Transition to implementation

  • Following approval, coordinate with Digital/Delivery to transfer the agreed concept, supporting analysis, business requirements and relevant POC findings for MVP development and implementation.
  • Where assigned, act as project owner or coordinate relevant project activities within the agreed governance arrangements. Accountability for implementation transfers to Digital/Delivery.
  • Budget, resource or external-partner responsibilities may be assigned depending on the approved initiative and are not standing responsibilities of the role.


Your profile

REQUIRED SKILLS, KNOWLEDGE & EXPERIENCE

  • Strong airline-industry background, with demonstrated experience in core airline businesses such as PRM, distribution, operational research and e-sales.
  • Broad understanding of airline business and technical domains, sufficient to assess a variety of potential initiatives.

jobs.title: UX Designer
jobs.description:
Of je jezelf nu UX Designer, Interaction Designer of Product Designer noemt: jij zorgt ervoor dat digitale producten en services logisch werken voor de mensen die ze gebruiken. Je beweegt makkelijk tussen strategie, gebruikersbehoeften, interactie en technologie. Van eerste inzicht en concept tot een uitgewerkt ontwerp dat daadwerkelijk gebouwd en gebruikt wordt.

Wat ga je doen als UX Designer bij Norday?

Bij Norday werken we aan complexe vraagstukken waarvoor niet altijd meteen duidelijk is wat de juiste oplossing is. Nieuwe technologie, veranderende verwachtingen en maatschappelijke ontwikkelingen vragen organisaties om richting te kiezen én die richting concreet te maken.

Als UX Designer help jij daarbij. Je vergroot de verbeeldingskracht van opdrachtgevers met scherpe inzichten en snelle prototypes. Je onderzoekt wat mensen nodig hebben, maakt complexe informatie begrijpelijk en vertaalt strategische keuzes naar digitale producten en services die in de praktijk werken. Je werkt daarbij nauw samen met strategen, service designers, visual designers, developers en projectmanagers.

Je werkt aan nieuwe digitale platforms, slimme tools, gepersonaliseerde ervaringen en nieuwe diensten. Soms ligt er al een duidelijke strategie, soms help je die samen met het team verder vormgeven. Je bent gedurende het hele proces betrokken: van het eerste vraagstuk en onderzoek tot concept, ontwerp, validatie en realisatie.

Wat je gaat doen:

  • Je duikt in de context van een vraagstuk en brengt gebruikers, behoeften, doelen en knelpunten in kaart;

  • Je vertaalt inzichten en strategie naar een concept, user flows, journeys en prototypes;

  • Je maakt complexe vraagstukken begrijpelijk en helpt klanten en teams om keuzes te maken;

  • Je faciliteert workshops en co-creatiesessies met klanten, gebruikers en collega’s;

  • Je bedenkt en test verschillende oplossingsrichtingen en gebruikt inzichten uit onderzoek om je ontwerp steeds verder aan te scherpen;

  • Je onderzoekt hoe AI kan bijdragen aan nieuwe diensten, betere ervaringen en waarde voor organisaties en de mensen die ze gebruiken;

  • Je zorgt dat interacties, flows en details helder zijn voor visual designers, developers én agents;

  • Je bewaakt de gebruikerservaring tot het product of de service daadwerkelijk werkt;

  • Je werkt samen met strategen en andere disciplines aan oplossingen die niet alleen prettig werken, maar bijdragen aan de richting en waarde van de organisatie.

Wie ben jij?

  • Je bent nieuwsgierig naar hoe mensen dingen gebruiken en waarom ze bepaalde keuzes maken. Je kunt goed luisteren, doorvragen en verbanden leggen. Tegelijkertijd ben je niet iemand die eindeloos blijft onderzoeken: je krijgt energie van het concreet maken van inzichten en het samenbrengen van verschillende perspectieven in een heldere oplossing.

  • Je kunt schakelen tussen het grotere verhaal en het detail. Je begrijpt wat een strategische keuze betekent voor een gebruikerservaring en weet wat er nodig is om een idee technisch en organisatorisch haalbaar te maken.

  • Je bent zelfstandig in je werk, zoekt actief de samenwerking op en kunt je ontwerpkeuzes goed uitleggen aan zowel klanten als collega’s. Je hoeft niet overal het antwoord op te hebben. Wel wil je begrijpen wat er speelt en samen tot een oplossing komen die klopt.

Onze ideale UX Designer …

  • heeft een aantal jaar ervaring als UX Designer, Interaction Designer of Product Designer;

  • heeft ervaring met complexe digitale vraagstukken en het ontwerpen van digitale producten of services;

  • kan zelfstandig onderzoek, conceptontwikkeling, interaction design en prototyping oppakken;

  • heeft ruime ervaring met Figma en bijvoorbeeld Miro of vergelijkbare tools;

  • vindt het leuk om workshops en co-creatiesessies te begeleiden;

  • kan goed samenwerken met strategen, service designers, visual designers en developers;

  • beheerst de Nederlandse taal goed, vanwege de grote mate van klantcontact, interviews, workshops en samenwerking;

  • heeft een HBO/WO werk- en denkniveau, bijvoorbeeld vanuit CMD, Design for Interaction of een vergelijkbare opleiding;

  • is nieuwsgierig naar de mogelijkheden van AI en experimenteert ermee in eigen processen. Je ziet AI als een nieuwe manier om onderzoek te doen, samen te werken, te ontwerpen en ideeën sneller te verkennen en toetsen.

Wat bieden we jou?

  • Een salaris van €3.600 tot €4.700 bruto per maand op basis van 40 uur, afhankelijk van jouw ervaring;

  • Hybride werken vanuit Rotterdam en thuis;

  • Een persoonlijk budget van €750 voor je thuiswerkplek;

  • 25 vakantiedagen;

  • Een goede pensioenregeling en leasefietsregeling;

  • Een NS Business Card;

  • Een persoonlijk leer- en ontwikkelplan en veel ruimte om te leren van collega’s en vakexperts;

  • Afwisselende projecten waarin strategie, design, technologie en domeinkennis samenkomen;

  • Een team van nieuwsgierige en betrokken collega’s die kwaliteit belangrijk vinden;

  • De mogelijkheid om mee te bouwen aan de verdere ontwikkeling van Norday.

Norday stimuleert een diverse werkomgeving en is een werkgever die gelijke kansen biedt. We moedigen sollicitanten van alle achtergronden en identiteiten aan om te solliciteren. Daarnaast nemen we sociale en ecologische impact mee in onze besluitvorming en in jouw performance reviews.

Vragen? Neem dan contact met ons op via 010 221 46 00 of

Norday: Ready to Lead

Norday helpt organisaties richting te geven aan verandering en hun veranderkracht te vergroten. We combineren strategie, design, technologie en domeinkennis om complexe vraagstukken concreet te maken en oplossingen te ontwikkelen die in de praktijk werken. Van transformatiestrategie, digitale en datastrategie tot nieuwe producten, diensten en AI-toepassingen: we gidsen organisaties bij waar ze naartoe willen en helpen ze om daar te komen.

We werken in multidisciplinaire teams samen met opdrachtgevers in cultuur, zorg en welzijn, educatie, overheden, NGO’s en climate tech aan de grote vraagstukken van deze tijd. Daarbij verbinden we de mogelijkheden van technologie met de context van organisaties en de mensen die ermee werken. Norday is onderdeel van Handpicked en een B Corp.

Bij Intus helpen wij onze klanten en hun medewerkers met slimmer plannen. Hierdoor dragen we bij aan het oplossen van één van de belangrijkste maatschappelijke uitdagingen: personeelskrapte. 

Onze producten brengen flexibiliteit en efficiëntie in het planningsproces en dat is fijn voor iedereen. Onze klanten kunnen onze medewerkers optimaal inzetten, terwijl we tegelijkertijd bijdragen aan meer werkgeluk en een gezonde werk-privé balans. Een win-win voor iedereen! 
 
Als projectmanager bij Intus speel je een cruciale rol in projecten bij onze diverse klanten in verschillende markten zoals zorg, overheid, industrie en logistiek. Je structureert en realiseert meerdere projecten tegelijkertijd van begin tot het eind. Dit kan gaan om het begeleiden van onze klanten bij het volledig implementeren van onze software InPlanning bij een nieuwe klant of het begeleiden van een complexe transformatie in het applicatielandschap bij een bestaande klant. Dankzij jouw vermogen om draagvlak te creëren en overzicht te behouden, help je klanten en zorg je voor een efficiënt verloop van de projecten.  
 
Je maakt deel uit van een team van projectmanagers en consultants die verantwoordelijk zijn voor alle projecten in Nederland. Als projectmanager ben jij tijdens een project hét aanspreekpunt voor de klant, met betrekking tot de voortgang, planning, kwaliteit, budget en uitvoering. Je werkt nauw samen met collega’s (o.a. implementatie consultants en technisch consultants) om de projecten te realiseren, en daarnaast heb je ook regelmatig contact met je collega-projectmanagers, accountmanagers, technisch consultants en product owners. Als projectmanager begeleidt je projecten van A tot Z wat betekent dat je de volgende verantwoordelijkheden hebt:

jobs.title: Senior Quality Engineer - Tellent Intelligence (AI)
jobs.description:
Note: The listed salary range is based on the salary range for the Netherlands. Salary ranges may vary by location.

About the Role

As a Senior Quality Engineer – Tellent Intelligence (AI), you'll own and grow the quality of the AI-powered experiences built by our Tellent Intelligence team alongside our existing QE team. You'll help shape how we test applications powered by large language models (LLMs) and AI agents, ensuring they are reliable, safe, and deliver high-quality experiences for our customers.

You'll expand our end-to-end test coverage in Playwright and help build robust approaches for validating AI-powered systems, where quality extends beyond functional correctness. This is a hands-on, collaborative role with genuine ownership, direct impact on product development, and the opportunity to shape how we test AI at Tellent.

Your 12-Month Journey

  • During your first 3 months: You'll get to know our Tellent Intelligence domain, engineering practices, AI-powered features, and quality standards. You'll learn our testing framework and development workflow while contributing to automated, exploratory, and AI-focused testing.

  • Within 6 months: You'll take ownership of quality across key AI-powered features, expand our Playwright test coverage, and work closely with engineers to validate AI behaviour, prompts, and model-driven functionality throughout development.

  • After 1 year: You'll be a trusted quality partner within the Tellent Intelligence team, driving improvements to our AI testing strategy, strengthening our automation framework, and helping shape how we build reliable, safe, and responsible AI experiences across Tellent.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Work closely with fellow Quality Engineers to bring our test automation strategy to life across the Tellent Intelligence domain, taking shared ownership and continuously improving it as our platform evolves.

  • Partner with developers, AI engineers, and fellow QEs to embed quality early in the development process, sharing knowledge and shaping testing practices collaboratively.

  • Design and execute comprehensive test plans, test cases, and automated test suites across frontend, backend, and AI-powered functionality.

  • Develop into a product domain expert, using your understanding to identify risks early and guide quality decisions across the Tellent Intelligence domain.

  • Design and execute testing strategies for AI-powered features, validating not only functional correctness but also the quality, relevance, consistency, and safety of AI-generated outputs.

  • Develop approaches for testing non-deterministic systems by creating evaluation datasets, defining quality benchmarks, and identifying hallucinations, bias, regressions, and prompt-related issues as models and prompts evolve.

  • Partner with engineers to validate prompt changes, AI agent behaviour, and safety guardrails, ensuring our AI behaves reliably and responsibly before reaching customers.

  • Continuously improve how we evaluate AI quality by helping establish best practices, quality metrics, and testing frameworks for LLM-powered applications.

What You Bring

  • Strong QA experience: Several years of hands-on quality engineering, with senior-level ownership of testing for complex web applications.

  • AI quality mindset: Experience testing AI-powered applications, LLM-based products, conversational AI, or machine learning systems is a strong plus. If you haven't worked directly with AI before, you're excited to learn and apply quality engineering principles to this rapidly evolving space.

  • E2E automation: Experience building and maintaining end-to-end test suites in Playwright.

  • API & backend testing skills: Experience testing APIs and backend services.

  • Balance of product and technical thinking: Equally at home discussing product behaviour and digging into technical detail.

  • Understanding of AI testing challenges: Familiarity with concepts such as prompt engineering, AI agents, hallucinations, model bias, evaluation datasets, and AI safety principles is a plus.

  • Analytical mindset: Comfortable defining quality expectations for systems where outputs may vary while still delivering a great user experience.

  • Communication: Fluent English for daily collaboration. Polish is a plus.

What We Offer

  • Hybrid or remote working setup across Amsterdam, the Cologne area, or Poland

  • A chance to shape one of the most ambitious scale-ups in Europe and lead a company-defining tech transition.

  • Work in a diverse, multicultural, and remote-friendly team.

  • €1,500 annual training budget + 2 dedicated learning days

  • Pension plan, travel reimbursement, and wellness perks.

  • 28 paid holiday days + 2 additional days to relax.

  • Work from anywhere for 4 weeks/year.

  • Apple MacBook and top-tier tooling.

  • €200 home office budget.

Please note: Benefits may differ based on your employment location.

About Tellent

Tellent is a leading Talent Management Suite designed to empower HR & People teams across the entire employee journey. Our all-in-one platform combines an Applicant Tracking System (Tellent Recruitee), an intuitive HRIS (Tellent HR), and powerful Performance Management software (Tellent Grow).

With 250+ team members globally, 7,000+ customers in 100+ countries, and a growing ecosystem of 500+ partners, we help organizations attract, grow, and retain top talent — and we’re just getting started.

AI in our recruitment process

We use our internally developed AI tools to help streamline our recruitment process. However, technology never makes a decision. Every candidate is personally reviewed by our team. Your journey with us is guided by people, supported by tech. Curious about how it works? Read our AI Statement, check our Privacy Policy, or chat with us at 

If you require accommodations or support during the recruitment process, please let us know — we’re happy to help.

jobs.title: Afstudeerstage IT
jobs.description:
Bij BAS, Europa’s grootste dealer in commerciële voertuigen én officieel Volvo en Renault Trucks dealer, krijg jij de kans om je te ontwikkelen binnen IT in de automotive branche. Ben jij op zoek naar een afstudeerstage vanaf januari/ februari 2027? Dan is dit iets voor jou!

BAS World groeit hard, en IT speelt daarin een sleutelrol. Binnen ons IT-team liggen verschillende afstudeeropdrachten klaar die elk een echt vraagstuk uit ons IT-landschap aanpakken. Elke opdracht heeft een eigen team dat je dagelijks begeleidt. Zo breng je je kennis in de praktijk en kickstart je samen met ons jouw carrière.

Mogelijke afstudeeropdrachten

1. Continuous performance & load testing (Engineering)
BAS World wil het aantal voertuigadvertenties online ongeveer 20 keer zo groot maken. In deze opdracht zorg je dat onze websites en systemen die groei aankunnen. Je onderzoekt welke (AI-gedreven) testtools passen bij onze stack. Daarna bouw je samen met het IDP-team een testsuite die dagelijks automatisch draait in de pipeline. Het resultaat is een productieklare testopzet en een advies over knelpunten en capaciteit.
Past bij: Software Engineering, DevOps, Infrastructure.

2. Kleine AI-agents voor de business (Data / AI engineering)
In deze opdracht werk je als interne consultant binnen één afdeling, bijvoorbeeld Logistiek. Je spreekt gebruikers, brengt hun processen en knelpunten in kaart en bepaalt waar AI het meeste oplevert. Daarna bouw je één of meer kleine AI-agents op basis van de services en data die we al hebben. Je test ze en verbetert ze tot ze echt gebruikt worden in het dagelijkse werk.
Past bij: AI, Data Science, Business IT, Software Engineering, als je graag dicht op eindgebruikers werkt.

3. Realtime monitoring & bottleneck-analyse voor Thinkwise-applicaties (Engineering)
Verschillende kernapplicaties draaien op het low-code platform Thinkwise. Als gebruikers traagheid melden, kost het nu weken om de oorzaak te vinden. In deze opdracht bouw je monitoring die de performance over de hele stack realtime inzichtelijk maakt: van UI en applicatielaag tot database en netwerk. Die performance komt live op een scherm op de werkvloer van onze developers. Daarnaast ontwikkel je rapportage- en analysetooling waarmee developers bottlenecks precies kunnen aanwijzen en oplossen waar ze ontstaan. Zo vinden we problemen in uren in plaats van weken.
Past bij: Software Engineering, Infrastructure, DevOps, met interesse in performance en observability.

4. Problem management & ITSM-procesoptimalisatie (System & Application Management)
Onze Servicedesk en het S&AM-team krijgen veel meldingen binnen in Jira. Terugkerende problemen worden nog te weinig bij de bron opgelost. In deze opdracht breng je de ITSM-processen in kaart en leg je ze vast: processtromen, werkinstructies en rollen. Je toetst ze aan good practices zoals ITIL. Daarna ontwerp en implementeer je problem management als een vast proces, zodat terugkerende issues structureel verdwijnen.
Past bij: Business IT & Management, IT Service Management of verwant.

5. Datagedreven leadgeneratie met FleetCareXL & BAS World (Product)
Via FleetCareXL weten we precies hoe voertuigen onderhouden worden en wat dat kost. De verkoophistorie van BAS World vertelt ons veel over restwaardes. In deze opdracht combineer je deze twee databronnen in een proof of concept. Die berekent het ideale vervangmoment: wanneer onderhoudskosten gaan stijgen terwijl de restwaarde nog hoog is. Dat levert kostenbesparing op voor klanten en leads voor in- en verkoop. De opdracht kan ook andersom worden ingevuld. Dan onderzoek je hoe we FleetGuide selfservice of fullservice actief kunnen aanbieden aan klanten van BAS World.
Past bij: Data Science, Business Analytics, Software Engineering, met commerciële interesse.

Kortom: veel verantwoordelijkheid, veel samenwerking en een opdracht met echte impact.

Wij bieden jou

  • Een stagevergoeding van €500,- bruto per maand voor een fulltime stage én reiskostenvergoeding;

jobs.title: Remote Financial Services Agent (Independent Contractor) – Inbound Card & Account Support
jobs.description:
Set your own hours, take inbound banking card calls from home, and earn up to $350 in certification bonuses. The contract has a pool of 20,000+ hours of work available every month.

Earnings at a Glance

  • $15.00–$17.00 per hour, plus performance incentives

  • $300 certification bonus once you complete 200 productive hours

  • +$50 bonus if you certify within 6 weeks

  • Choose your own hours. Coverage runs 24/7, every day

  • Remote, U.S.-based, 1099 independent contractor

The Opportunity

Help cardholders manage their money with confidence. You'll take inbound calls from people who rely on their cards for everyday life. They might be activating a new card, replacing a lost one, sorting out a disputed charge, or getting a time-sensitive payment through. These moments matter, and you're the person who makes them go smoothly.

What the Work Involves

  • Inbound calls on card activation, replacements, lost or stolen cards, balances, and account questions

  • Payments, transfers, and disputes, handled accurately and securely

  • Identity verification and strict security and compliance protocols on every call

  • Spotting potential fraud and helping resolve it with composure

  • Accurate documentation of every interaction

You're a Fit If You Bring

  • Clear, empathetic phone communication, even when callers are stressed

  • Care for protecting sensitive financial information

  • Comfort moving between multiple systems at once

  • Composure and problem-solving in a fast-paced environment

  • Strong plus: banking, card, financial services, or contact center experience

Your Path to Starting Work

  1. Week 1: Apply. Create your ShyftOff account and apply to the Financial Services campaign.

  2. Weeks 2–3: Screening & credentialing. Federal background check, fingerprinting, drug screening, and credential issuance.

  3. Weeks 4–5: Certification. Simulations and scored mock calls. Standards and examples of required work product are demonstrated.

  4. Week 6: Practice calls & go-live. Show that your work meets the program's accuracy and quality standards, then start choosing open hours.

Screening Cost: Please Read Before Applying

This is a federally backed program, so every contractor must complete third-party credentialing before taking live calls. As an independent contractor, you pay these providers directly:

  • Extensive federal background check

  • Fingerprinting

  • Drug screening

  • YubiKey security device (yours to keep)

Total: $299, paid to third-party providers. It's due only when you move into credentialing, not at sign-up.

What You'll Need

  • Ability to pass federal background, fingerprint, and drug screening

  • A quiet home workspace and reliable high-speed internet

  • Commitment to completing self-paced certification (about 6 weeks)

How to Apply

  1. Create your agent account at https://www.shyftoff.com/agents

  2. Apply to the Financial Services campaign from your dashboard

This is an independent contractor (1099) opportunity. You set your own schedule, work remotely, and provide your own workspace and equipment.

jobs.title: Outbound SDR — Technology Advisory (Self-Employed, Remote)
jobs.location: Poland, the Philippines or South Africa
jobs.description:
CTO Samurai is a technology advisory helping tech teams dramatically boost delivery speed and output using AI. We work with founders and CTOs who want far more from the teams they already have, and we show them how. https://www.ctosamurai.com 

We're looking for a self-employed outbound SDR to book qualified discovery calls with UK & Ireland-based tech decision-makers (CTOs, Heads of Engineering, founders). This is a one-month paid competitive trial — you'll run alongside one other SDR candidate, 100% commission, no cap. The stronger performer at the end of the month is offered an ongoing contract on a monthly retainer + commission.

What you'll do

  • Source and outreach 60–75 targeted touches per day (LinkedIn, email, fundraising boards, company/SIC-code lists)
  • Qualify and book calls into our closer's calendar
  • Work closely with our Promoter/closer — you own lead quality, they own conversion, and you'll both be measured on the same downstream numbers

Trial compensation

  • £20 per qualified call booked
  • £250 per paid Audit that call converts into
  • No retainer, no cap — strong performers can significantly outearn a typical SDR salary in month one

Ongoing contract (for the trial winner)

  • £1,000/month retainer + £10 per qualified call + £125 per paid Audit
  • Ongoing commission on every high-ticket Agentic Transformation package sold from your pipeline
  • Worth £24,000–£32,000 a year OTE at target (around £30,000 with one Transformation sale a month)

Tools you'll need to be comfortable with

  • LinkedIn Sales Navigator
  • Apollo (or equivalent outbound/prospecting platform)
  • CRM/pipeline tracking tools for logging activity and call outcomes
  • Email outreach/sequencing tools

Who we're looking for

  • Proven outbound/cold-outreach experience — you can show a track record of booked meetings, not just activity
  • Comfortable selling into technical buyers even without a deep tech background (we'll equip you with the pitch)
  • Self-starter who can hit daily touch volume without heavy oversight
  • Based in Poland, the Philippines, or South Africa (fully remote), working as an independent contractor: you invoice us monthly and handle your own local taxes

Why work with us

  • Sell a genuinely differentiated, high-ticket offer (not another SaaS trial)
  • Direct line of sight from your activity to your earnings
  • Fast path to an ongoing, well-paid contract if you perform

How to apply

Apply online at https://forms.gle/28ehuKPTanKA8Erh9. The form takes about 20–25 minutes and includes two short writing tasks: a cold outreach email and a LinkedIn message sequence.

At Peroptyx, we are looking for Data Analysts who will review mapping data for digital mapping applications. Your research capabilities will validate and ensure that the navigation of certain routes are accurate and safe.

 

As part of this role you will verify that business names and opening hours are correct. You will check that the distance from a starting point to an end destination is listed accurately, resulting in better user experiences.

 

With this job you can plan your days around this highly flexible working schedule, work weekends or late evenings, all from the comfort of your own office. The flexibility of our roles minimizes the impact on your daily routine.

 

So, whether you are a student looking to earn as you learn, a retiree looking for a new challenge, a part-time/full time professional or a work from home parent, Peroptyx has the right role for you!

 

Benefits

  • Work up to 20 hours per week.

  • Earn a competitive rate of pay.

  • Develop your research skills.

  • Avoid the long commute.

  • Work from the comfort of your home office.

  • Enjoy the flexibility of setting your own working hours!

 

Ideal Candidate

  • Fluent in English and Japanese.

  • Excellent research skills.

  • Excellent local knowledge of your home country.

  • Good understanding and general knowledge of the geography and culture of Japan.

  • Analytical mindset.

 

Job Requirements

  • Must be living in Japan for a minimum of 5 consecutive years.

  • Must pass an online open-book exam that can verify your full understanding of the material and concepts.

  • All work must be of an independent nature.

 

Apply Online Today!

jobs.title: Content Reviewer United States - English-speaking
jobs.description:
TELUS Digital AI Community

Our global AI Community is a vibrant network of more than one million contributors from diverse backgrounds who help customers collect, enhance, train, translate, and localize content to build better AI models. Become part of our growing community and contribute to the development of innovative AI technologies used by some of the world's largest brands.

We are looking for an independent, flexible, remote opportunity where you can help improve AI-powered search technology from the comfort of your home? If you're curious, internet-savvy, and enjoy evaluating online content, this freelance project could be a great fit.

 

A Day in the Life of a Content Reviewer - US

In this role, you will analyze and provide feedback on text, webpages, images, and other types of online content for leading search engines using a specialized online platform.

By reviewing and rating search results for relevance and quality, you will help improve the overall search experience for millions of users around the world, including yourself.

Join our global community and put your skills to work supporting one of the world's leading search technologies.

 

Service Rates 

The rate of pay is $0.2333 per completed task, with an estimated earning potential of $14 per hour. Compensation is based on tasks completed and project availability. Estimated earnings may vary depending on task volume and program requirements including, quality, and productivity, in accordance with the program's quality standards and guidelines.

Please note that only one member per household may participate in this program. If it is identified that more than one person from the same household is participating in the TELUS Digital Rating Program, all associated accounts may be removed from the program.

 

Independent Contractor Relationship

This opportunity is offered on an independent contractor basis. Contributors have the flexibility to choose when and how much they work, subject to project availability and quality requirements. This opportunity is not and should not be construed as creating an employment relationship with TELUS Digital.

 

Qualification path

Qualification Process

No previous professional experience is required to apply for this opportunity. However, participation in this project requires meeting the basic requirements and successfully completing the qualification process.

 

Basic Requirements

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English

• Must have resided in the United States for the past three consecutive years

• Familiarity with current and historical business, media, sports, news, social media, and cultural affairs in the United States

• Active use of Gmail and social media platforms

• Experience using web browsers to navigate and interact with a variety of online content

• Daily access to a reliable broadband internet connection

• Access to a smartphone (Android 5.0 or higher, or iOS 14 or higher)

• Access to a personal computer

 

Assessment

You must complete an English language assessment, pass an open book qualification exam, and complete an ID verification in order to be successful for this role. These assessments will determine your suitability for the position.

jobs.title: Quality Assurance Rater - Spanish (ES)
jobs.description:
Join our elite team of Senior Raters as a critical contributor to high-quality validation data that directly influences product development and quality assurance for leading search engines and AI technologies.

This flexible, remote opportunity allows you to apply your analytical and research skills to evaluate search results and AI-generated content while contributing to the development of high-quality AI systems.

 

A Day in the Life of a Quality Assurance Rater

In this role, you'll conduct analytical assessments of search results and AI responses, providing ratings and feedback that help improve AI model performance and search quality.

Your work will maintain high quality standards and deliver the accuracy our clients depend on.

You'll evaluate a variety of rating tasks, analyze content with attention to detail, conduct research to support rating decisions, and identify guideline gaps or task inconsistencies.

You'll also participate in training and calibration sessions while contributing feedback to improve rating processes and guidelines.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Evaluate search results and AI-generated content for quality, relevance, accuracy, and usefulness.
  • Conduct online research to verify information and support rating decisions.
  • Apply rating guidelines consistently while maintaining quality standards.
  • Document edge cases, guideline gaps, and task-related issues.
  • Provide clear written feedback and rationale for ratings when required.
  • Participate in training, calibration sessions, and ongoing quality reviews.
  • Meet productivity expectations while maintaining high-quality work.

 

The hourly earnings for this role are 18 EUR per hour, payment is based on completed tasks.

 

TELUS Digital AI Community

Our global AI Community is a vibrant network of 1 million+ contributors from diverse backgrounds who help our customers collect, enhance, train, translate, and localize content to build better AI models. Become part of our growing community and make an impact supporting the machine learning models of some of the world’s largest brands. 

Qualification path

 

Candidates will complete project-specific training and qualification assessments before joining the program. Ongoing work will be subject to regular quality assurance reviews and performance monitoring.

 

Basic Requirements

  • Working as a freelancer with excellent communication skills in Spanish & English.
  • Resident in Spain for the last 5 consecutive years.
  • Familiarity with current and historical business, media, sports, news, social media, and cultural affairs.
  • Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and research skills.
  • Experience using web browsers, search engines, and online research tools.
  • Daily access to a reliable broadband internet connection, smartphone, and personal computer.
  • Demonstrated research capability through professional background OR strong track record of self-directed research and information verification
  • Ability to work independently and follow detailed guidelines consistently.
  • High level of creativity and logical skills with the ability to achieve consistent targets

 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in quality assurance, content moderation, data annotation, research, journalism, editing, or information verification.
  • Familiarity with AI technologies, search engines, and digital content ecosystems.
  • Subject matter expertise in areas such as Popular Culture, Social Sciences, STEM, Medicine, Law, Finance, or Engineering.
  • Additional language skills may be beneficial depending on project requirements.

 

Equal Opportunity

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for a contractual relationship without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status. At TELUS Digital AI, we are proud to offer equal opportunities and are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive community. All aspects of selection are based on applicants’ qualifications, merits, competence, and performance without regard to any characteristic related to diversity.

jobs.title: Storyteller: Freelance B2B Interviewer and Writer
jobs.location: EMEA or APAC time zones only
jobs.description:
About the Role

Elite Editing is seeking experienced freelance journalists and content professionals to support our growing customer reference and case study programs. We call this our Storyteller role, and we are specifically looking for experienced professionals based in EMEA and APAC time zones.

Our Storytellers own the storytelling process from interview through finished draft. They lead kickoff calls with our clients and their internal stakeholders, interview their customers and subject matter experts (SMEs), identify the strongest narrative angles within the information they gather, and then write compelling case studies and customer reference stories that adhere to client-specific standards and style guides.

This is more than simply working through a list of prepared questions—or turning a transcript into copy. We need skilled storytellers who listen closely, recognize when an answer deserves further exploration, ask intelligent follow-up questions, identify the details that make a story worth telling, and then shape that material into polished, engaging content.

Our ideal freelancer has a journalism or professional interviewing background paired with extensive professional writing experience and strong editorial judgment. You should be comfortable speaking with senior business leaders, technical SMEs, and other professionals; able to quickly understand unfamiliar or complex subject matter; and skilled at transforming what you learn into a clear and compelling narrative.

What You'll Do

You will:

  • Conduct virtual kickoff calls with client stakeholders to understand the goals, context, audience, and desired direction of customer reference stories.
  • Conduct virtual interviews with our clients' customers and SMEs, often involving senior-level or highly technical professionals.
  • Review project background materials and prepare for interviews in advance.
  • Use provided interview guides as a starting point while adapting questions to the conversation.
  • Ask thoughtful, unscripted follow-up questions that uncover meaningful details, examples, outcomes, challenges, and quotable insights.
  • Identify and develop the strongest story angles from interviews, background materials, and client input.
  • Write polished B2B case studies and customer reference stories based on the information you gather, following client-specific briefs, templates, standards, and style guides.
  • Synthesize complex or technical information into accurate, accessible, and engaging narratives for the intended audience.
  • Maintain a professional, confident, and personable presence while representing Elite and our clients on calls.
  • Work collaboratively with Elite's project managers, editors, and other members of the content team throughout the development and revision process.
  • Follow client-specific processes, confidentiality requirements, and project instructions.

Job Requirements

Successful candidates must:

  • Have substantial professional writing experience, with a portfolio demonstrating the ability to develop clear, engaging, publication-ready content.
  • Have professional experience conducting interviews, preferably in journalism, B2B content, tech, publishing, corporate communications, or a related field.
  • Be located in EMEA or APAC time zones.
  • Have excellent spoken and written English and exceptional verbal communication skills.
  • Be an exceptional listener who can think on their feet and pursue useful lines of questioning in real time.
  • Be comfortable interviewing senior executives, business leaders, customers, and subject matter experts.
  • Be able to absorb unfamiliar information quickly and ask credible, informed questions about complex topics.
  • Have strong editorial judgment and be able to identify the narrative, details, and supporting evidence that will make a compelling story.
  • Be able to synthesize interviews, transcripts, background materials, and client input into a cohesive finished piece.
  • Be highly reliable, organized, responsive, and comfortable working within established processes and deadlines.
  • Have a professional remote-work setup, including reliable high-speed internet and high-quality audio/video capabilities.

Preferred Qualifications

We're especially interested in candidates with one or more of the following:

  • A professional journalism background, particularly experience developing reported stories from initial research and interviews through finished copy.
  • Experience interviewing executives and subject matter experts.
  • Experience with B2B technology, enterprise technology, SaaS, cloud computing, professional services, or other complex industries.
  • Experience developing customer stories, customer reference content, case studies, thought leadership, or other long-form B2B content.
  • Experience working with or for a content, marketing, communications, or creative agency.
  • Familiarity with agency workflows in which freelancers work as part of a larger client delivery team.
  • Experience conducting interviews and developing content on behalf of major brands or enterprise organizations.
  • The ability to make interview subjects feel comfortable while keeping conversations focused and productive.

Prior agency experience is helpful but not required. We are much more interested in finding outstanding storytellers with excellent interviewing skills, writing ability, editorial judgment, curiosity, and professionalism.

Freelance Relationship

This is a freelance opportunity rather than a full-time staff position. Work will be offered based on project needs, Storyteller availability, subject-matter fit, and time zone.

Elite manages the broader client relationship, project workflow, and content production process. Freelancers work within established project parameters and compensation structures and collaborate with Elite's internal team and other content professionals to deliver the work.

Because interviews are scheduled with clients and their customers, this work requires the ability to commit to agreed-upon call times and arrive fully prepared.

About Elite Editing

Elite Editing is a woman-owned, fully remote strategic content agency based in Baltimore, Maryland. Founded in 2008, Elite began as an editing company and has grown into a full-service content partner supporting organizations with content strategy, writing, editing, marketing and sales enablement, AI implementation, and program management.

Our clients range from small businesses, publishers, agencies, universities, and thought leaders to some of the world's leading enterprise organizations. Our global network of writers, editors, interviewers, project managers, and other content professionals helps clients create high-quality content at scale.

Elite's approach is highly collaborative. We build specialized teams around our clients and integrate our processes with theirs, supporting everything from kickoff and research through SME interviewing, writing, editing, and final delivery.

We're serious about quality, but we're equally serious about being good people to work with. Our culture emphasizes trust, adaptability, collaboration, high standards, and finding a way to say "yes" to challenging work.

Who We'd Love to Hear From

You may be an especially strong fit if you've spent part of your career as a journalist and have since moved into freelance B2B, corporate, or branded content—or if you continue to work in journalism while taking on select commercial assignments.

If you know how to interview people well, recognize the story hiding within a conversation, and turn that raw material into compelling finished content, we'd like to hear from you.

jobs.title: Virtual Bookkeeper
jobs.description:
About Strong Roots Accounting

Strong Roots Accounting is a small accounting firm based in Fort Worth, Texas, serving small businesses and nonprofits with accurate, reliable bookkeeping and financial insight. We are not a factory. We are not a revolving door. We are a close-knit, values-driven team that operates with intention — every client gets one point of contact, consistent communication, and work they can count on every single month.

We exist to be a collaborative partner to businesses and individuals, providing accurate, reliable insights that allow them to make informed decisions with confidence and grow. Our vision is bigger than bookkeeping: we are building something that creates meaningful opportunities for people to build long-lasting stability and confidence in their future.

We are growing — intentionally and carefully — and we are looking for the right person to grow with us.

This Is Who We Are

We operate by a set of values and principles that are non-negotiable. They are not posted on a wall and forgotten. They are how we show up every day.

Core Values:

  • Trust

  • Quality

  • Contribution

Our Principles:

  • Honesty and accuracy above all.

  • Be curious. Ask why. And solve problems.

  • Rapid, responsive, and reliable communication.

  • Repeatable processes are the only option.

If you read those and felt something — keep reading. If you read those and they felt like just words, this is not the right fit, and that is okay.

This Is Who We Are NOT Looking For

We are a small team doing meaningful work. There is no room for the following:

  • People who cut corners and hope no one notices

  • People who go quiet when things get hard

  • People who need to be micromanaged to deliver

  • People who treat accuracy as optional

  • People who are not genuinely curious about the work they do

  • People who are not committed to the client behind the numbers

If any of that describes you, we genuinely wish you well — just not here.

The Role

The person best suited for this job is organized, detail-oriented, and personable. If you like to put your headphones on and dive into the numbers, you'll love this job.

Our team gets to complete something from start to finish every day — there's real joy in putting your head down and checking tasks off one by one. But this role takes more than the obvious skills. The person who thrives here is caring: caring about the work itself, about what it means for the client, for their peers, and for the company as a whole. That caring is what drives someone to get the details right, ask the question instead of guessing, and take pride in a quality product. It also takes someone intrinsically motivated. We won't be standing over your shoulder — we trust you to hold yourself accountable and stay on track.

Strong Roots is the most mission-minded place many of our team members have ever worked. We care about our people first, and that shows up in the quality of our work, the strength of our client relationships, and the culture we've built together.

This is a remote, backend bookkeeping position supporting our Client Relationship Manager. You will not have direct contact with clients — your job is to execute the bookkeeping work accurately, quietly, and on time so our team can deliver a seamless experience on the client-facing side.

You will manage end-of-month reconciliations across approximately 30 small business and nonprofit client accounts. Work is assigned by our Client Relationship Manager, who will be your primary point of contact for priorities, questions, and feedback.

This role may be part-time or full-time — we are open to the right fit and will discuss arrangements with the right candidate.

What You Will Do

  • Perform end-of-month bank reconciliations across a portfolio of small business and nonprofit clients

  • Categorize and organize transactions accurately within QuickBooks Online

  • Ensure client books are clean, consistent, and completed on time every month

  • Flag discrepancies or unusual items to the Client Relationship Manager for review

  • Follow established processes and SOPs for each client account

  • Maintain accuracy and confidentiality across all client files at all times

What We Are Looking For

Required:

  • Minimum 2 years of bookkeeping experience, preferably with U.S.-based clients

  • Proficiency in QuickBooks Online — this is non-negotiable

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and/or Google Sheets

  • Familiarity with Xero is a plus

  • Strong written and spoken English — you will communicate regularly with our team

  • High attention to detail and an uncompromising commitment to accuracy

  • Reliable internet connection and a dedicated, professional remote work setup

  • Ability to work during U.S. Central Standard Time hours or with meaningful overlap

  • Self-directed — you manage your workload, you meet your deadlines, you ask when you are unsure

Nice to have:

  • Experience with nonprofit accounting

  • Prior experience working remotely with U.S.-based accounting firms

  • Familiarity with bookkeeping across multiple industries

How to Apply

If you read this entire posting and felt like it described the kind of team you want to be part of, we want to hear from you.

Email katelynn@strongrootsaccounting.com with the subject line "ROOTS" and include:

1.  A brief introduction — who you are, your bookkeeping experience, and the types of clients you have worked with

2.  Your resume or CV

3.  Two or three sentences in English telling us what honesty and accuracy mean to you in your work

4.  Your availability and whether you are interested in part-time or full-time work

Applications that do not follow these instructions will not be reviewed. This is the first test.

jobs.description:
About Lemon.io

Lemon.io is a profitable, growing talent marketplace that connects vetted senior engineers with companies that need them. We’ve been in business for 10 years, have 60 people across Ukraine, Europe, Canada, and the US, and process over $16M in annual GMV. We compress the traditional 2–5 week hiring timeline down to 24–48 hours through a curated, pre-vetted supply of developers.

Hiring is still broken. Recruiters spend weeks building candidate pipelines on traditional platforms, burning energy on unqualified leads. We’re building the product that changes that. Giving recruiters qualified, vetted candidates within 24 hours without the grind. This is a pivotal moment: we’re transitioning from a services-driven marketplace to a technology-driven platform. We need an engineering leader who can drive that transformation.

The Role

You will own engineering at Lemon.io. You’ll lead a growing team of engineers, make critical architecture and prioritization decisions, and be directly accountable for the speed and quality of what we ship. This is not a management-layer role. You’ll be hands-on, deeply involved in product decisions, and working side by side with the founder.

What You’ll Do:

  • Own the technical roadmap and make sure every engineering effort maps directly to business impact. No features for features’ sake.
  • Lead and grow an engineering team that ships fast, iterates constantly, and treats complexity as a cost.
  • Tackle the hard, multi-layered problem: automated vetting, intelligent matching at scale, demand-side bottlenecks. And figure out where the real leverage is.
  • Make hard prioritization calls. Decide what we build, what we skip, and what we kill.
  • Work directly with the founder and product team to define what success looks like before writing a single line of code.
  • Build the engineering culture: high ownership, high speed, low bureaucracy.

Who You Are:

  • Product-minded, business-first
  • Obsessed with simplicity
  • First principles thinker
  • Fast. Bias toward action

Experience:

jobs.title: Phone Sales Agent - Restock
jobs.description:
Phone Sales Agent, Restock:

We are seeking a motivated and dedicated Phone Sales Agent to join our Restock team. In this role, you’ll reach out to loyal customers who are running low on the products they already know and love, and help them reorder before they run out.

These are warm conversations with people who have already bought from us and already like what we sell. You’re not cold calling. You’re the person who calls at exactly the right moment, makes reordering easy, and keeps their routine uninterrupted. This is a base pay + commission position with uncapped earning potential, making it perfect for individuals who thrive in a performance-driven environment.

What You’ll Do:

  • Call, text, and email existing customers whose supply is running low, and secure the reorder before they run out.

  • Work an assigned queue of reorder opportunities daily, following the established call and follow-up cadence.

  • Review each customer’s purchase history and order details before you dial, so every conversation is accurate and personalized.

  • Recommend the right product and the right quantity based on where the customer is in their routine.

  • Introduce complementary products that pair well with what the customer already uses, and grow the value of every order.

  • Follow up persistently and professionally across phone, SMS, and email to keep customers engaged and drive conversion.

  • Build rapport with repeat customers so they look forward to hearing from you.

  • Maintain accurate records of every customer interaction and sales activity in our CRM.

  • Meet or exceed individual sales targets on a weekly and monthly basis.

What You Bring to The Table:

  • Strong work ethic and self-motivation to drive sales results.

  • Comfort and proficiency with manual dialing and reaching out to leads.

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to engage customers via phone, email, and text.

  • Comfort working inside a CRM and order management system, with strong attention to detail on customer records.

  • A consultative approach, with the instinct to listen first and sell second.

  • A positive attitude and a passion for sales.

  • Ability to work independently and handle rejection with resilience.

  • Ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

  • Prior experience in phone sales or telemarketing is a plus, but not required.

Technical Must Have’s:

  • We require a stable internet connection (50+mbps Up & down)capable of supporting seamless voice and zoom communications, and data transfer, with an Octane Speed of 20,000 or greater (https://chromium.github.io/octane/).

  • A backup system for power and internet.

  • A fast and reliable laptop or desktop computer, with working camera, and a working noise-cancelling headset. You will be on Zoom with your team throughout the day.

Compensation:

  • Base pay

  • 4+% commission on sales revenue (minus refunds). Your commission rate tiers up as you hit higher performance levels, so top producers earn a higher percentage on the same revenue.

  • Uncapped earning potential

  • Weekly and monthly performance bonuses, including top average order value, top weekly sales, QA excellence, and perfect attendance.

Schedule:

  • Full time (35-45 hrs per week)

  • Schedules vary between 9:00am and 7:00pm CT

  • Must be available to work weekends
